title: Label-Dependent Demixing
Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
Balanced empirical condition means should approach the known mean-effect tensors as independent trial counts increase.
Global PCA may reconstruct the combined mean signal well without assigning individual components to task labels.
Separate marginal PCA should compress each provided marginal effectively, but it is given the marginal target directly and therefore does not demonstrate isolation from the full mean tensor.
Regularized dPCA should trade marginal isolation against reconstruction by learning a map from the full condition-mean tensor to each target marginal (Kobak et al. 2016).
Encoder directions may align with true mixing directions, while decoder directions need not: with oblique effects, dPCA can use a nonorthogonal readout/reconstruction pair.
Near-collinear stimulus and decision directions should increase cross-marginal confusion or instability. The empirical direction and magnitude are reported rather than guaranteed.
A missing factorial cell makes the balanced four-cell marginalization unidentified from the observed training design. A pseudoinverse extrapolation is a diagnostic, not valid recovery.
Joint label shuffling should remove systematic label alignment in expectation while preserving observations and cell counts.
Feature-wise pseudo-population permutation should preserve each feature’s condition means exactly but alter simultaneous cross-feature trial covariance and potentially change single-trial decoding.
A condition-mean-trained map can generalize to independent condition means while performing materially differently on noisy single trials. One endpoint does not validate the other.

title: Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
Use the primary generator, all four complete cells, and the balanced counts above. This is the only condition used for primary marginal-recovery acceptance.



Keep \(a_s\) fixed. Let
\[
r_\perp=
\frac{a_d-a_s(a_s^\top a_d)}
{\lVert a_d-a_s(a_s^\top a_d)\rVert_2}
\]
and replace
\[
a_d^{\mathrm{collinear}}
=
\frac{a_s+0.06r_\perp}{\lVert a_s+0.06r_\perp\rVert_2}.
\]
The resulting acute angle is approximately \(\arctan(0.06)=3.43^\circ\). Labels remain balanced and the temporal profiles remain different. True stimulus and decision marginal effects still exist, but their feature-space directions are practically difficult to separate. Report full confusion and stability; do not force a binary pass/fail based only on one angle.



Use cell order
\[
(-1,-1),\ (-1,+1),\ (+1,-1),\ (+1,+1)
\]
with counts:



Split
Cell counts




train
\((40,30,16,0)\)


validation
\((20,15,8,0)\)


test
\((30,30,30,30)\)



The fourth training and validation cell is absent. Therefore the full intercept/stimulus/decision/interaction design has rank below four, and the balanced factorial mean tensor is not identified from those splits. The implementation may compute a minimum-norm weighted least-squares or pseudoinverse extrapolation for a named negative-control diagnostic, but it must record the design rank and label every resulting marginal, dPCA fit, and test score invalid as balanced-cell recovery. It may not silently fill the cell, apply the balanced formulas, or treat extrapolation as observed condition evidence.
If a future variant uses unequal but nonzero counts, it must first estimate each cell mean and then assign explicit equal-cell weights to target the balanced factorial estimand. Trial-frequency weighting answers a different question and must receive a different label.



For the balanced condition, jointly permute the \((s,d)\) label pairs among complete training trials using fixed shuffle seeds while preserving the exact four cell counts. Observations, validation labels, and test labels remain unchanged. Use one frozen shuffle for the complete dPCA negative-control fit and 32 predeclared shuffle seeds for stimulus/decision decoding null summaries.
Every shuffled fit repeats condition-mean estimation, marginalization, regularization selection, fitting, and scoring. Shuffling only component labels after fitting is prohibited. Shuffled results are null controls, not alternative scientific decompositions.



Within each split and \((s,d)\) cell, independently permute whole-trial identities for each feature. A feature’s complete 24-bin trajectory moves together, but different features generally come from different original trials. This construction:

preserves labels and every feature’s cell-wise condition mean exactly;
preserves each feature’s univariate trial distribution;
destroys simultaneous feature-to-feature trial identity and changes the rank-one noise covariance contribution; and
cannot support claims about simultaneously available population noise correlations.

Mean-based marginalizations and condition-mean dPCA maps should therefore remain equal within the declared algebra tolerance. The realized maximum fitted-map discrepancy is \(8.52\times10^{-15}\), consistent with floating-point summation order rather than a scientific change. Trial-level covariance and decoding may change. Any apparent improvement is not evidence that pseudo-populations are superior data; it reflects a changed noise structure.



Fit dPCA only on training condition means. Evaluate the frozen maps in two distinct ways:

Mean-map transfer: apply each map to independent validation/test condition-mean tensors and compare with their empirical balanced marginals.
Single-trial transfer: apply the same maps to each centered test trial and compare with the corresponding noiseless generator effect tensor for that trial’s \((s,d)\) labels. Also report reconstruction against the noisy observed trial as a separately named descriptive metric.

The second endpoint contains trial noise absent from the fit objective. It is not a likelihood and is not expected to equal condition-mean performance.

title: Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
The implementation and verifier must assert:

Shape and split integrity: every trial array has shape (trials, 24, 12); all trial identifiers are disjoint across train, validation, and test.
Generator algebra: noiseless trial signals equal the sum of the four declared effects within \(10^{-12}\).
Balanced marginal algebra: grouped marginals sum to the centered condition-mean tensor within \(10^{-10}\) and are pairwise Frobenius-orthogonal under uniform cell weighting.
Truth access boundary: replacing every retained noiseless signal, effect, profile, and mixing-direction array leaves fitted means, marginalizations, lambda selection, PCA, dPCA, decoders, and observation-only predictions unchanged.
No test leakage: poisoning test observations or labels leaves training and validation preprocessing, condition means, selected lambdas, fitted maps, and decoder parameters unchanged.
No validation leakage into candidates: candidate dPCA maps use training means only; validation chooses among already fitted grid candidates; test never selects a candidate.
PCA oracle: global PCA’s projector matches the centered condition-mean SVD rank-four projector within \(10^{-10}\).
Reduced-rank oracle: every dPCA map has numerical rank at most one and agrees with the declared ridge-map-plus-leading-SVD construction within \(10^{-10}\).
Finite solves: every regularized Gram matrix is symmetric and positive definite for the positive grid; the selected map is finite. The unregularized boundary is not in this grid.
Lambda selection: the stored dPCA lambda equals the minimum validation mean normalized marginal error under the frozen tie rule; decoder lambdas equal their independent validation-accuracy selections.
Direction applicability: dPCA and separate-PCA encoder directions receive marginal-direction angles; dPCA decoder directions do not masquerade as generative mixing directions. Global PCA receives only a combined-signal-subspace angle.
Full confusion reporting: all 16 recovered-marginal/source-marginal energy entries exist; a scalar demixing index cannot replace them.
Shuffle integrity: the joint-label permutation preserves cell counts exactly, changes labels, leaves observations unchanged, and refits all supervised steps.
Missing-cell guard: the absent-cell design rank is recorded as deficient; no metric from that fit is labelled valid balanced recovery.
Pseudo-population oracle: labels and feature-wise cell means are exactly preserved, while at least one off-diagonal trial-noise covariance changes by more than numerical tolerance.
Trial-averaging labels: mean-map and single-trial rows use different targets and metric names.
Metric schema: all metric keys are unique, labels are nonempty, values are finite, and inapplicable metrics are omitted rather than encoded as zero.
Determinism: clean temporary regeneration yields byte-identical manifest.json, metrics.csv, diagnostics.json, and summary.png.

These checks establish reproducibility and implementation consistency, not causal or biological validity.

title: Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
Balanced formulas on a missing cell: a fabricated or silently extrapolated cell invalidates the factorial estimand.
Trial-frequency weighting called balanced marginalization: unequal counts then change the target and confound main effects with label prevalence.
Time bins split across folds: adjacent bins from one trial are not independent held-out units.
Marginal truth passed to fitting: true effects or directions may be used only for final simulation scoring and implementation oracles.
Separate marginal PCA called demixing: it receives the marginal target directly and need not isolate that target from full activity.
Global PCA components assigned task labels post hoc: a rank-four signal subspace does not provide a unique labelled basis.
Decoder aligned to encoder by force: oblique encoder/decoder geometry is part of the dPCA solution, not an error to rotate away using truth.
Only the largest demixing label reported: a high maximum can hide substantial cross-marginal energy.
Shuffle performed after fitting: this does not test the supervised fitting pipeline.
Pseudo-population decoding treated as simultaneous population decoding: independently permuted features do not coexist on one trial.
Condition-mean recovery generalized to single trials: trial averaging suppresses noise and is part of the estimand.
Decoding equated with reconstruction or representation: accuracy tests label predictability under a classifier protocol, not preservation of the mean tensor or a unique internal code.
Demixing equated with independence: different marginal components can be correlated and axes can be nonorthogonal (Machens 2010; Kobak et al. 2016).
Supervised labels treated as causal variables: an experimentally supplied label can correlate with omitted variables, choices, errors, or selection procedures.
Time marginal called dynamics: indexed temporal variation is not a transition law, vector field, autonomous system, or mechanism.
Clean plots replace held-out metrics: visualization does not verify marginal algebra, transfer, leakage, or label handling.

title: Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
The direct condition-mean record reports empirical train/validation/test marginal tensors and their normalized error against the retained noiseless generator effects. This measures sampling error before dimensionality reduction. It is not a learned projection method.



For flattened centered condition means \(X\in\mathbb R^{12\times96}\) and each grouped marginal \(X_\phi\):

global PCA fits one rank-four projector \(P\) on training \(X\) and reconstructs held-out marginal \(\phi\) as \(PX_\phi^{\mathrm{test}}\); equivalently, linear marginalization of \(PX^{\mathrm{test}}\) yields the same term;
separate marginal PCA fits a rank-one projector \(P_\phi\) on training \(X_\phi\) and reconstructs \(P_\phi X_\phi^{\mathrm{test}}\);
dPCA fits a rank-one map \(A_\phi\) from full training \(X\) to target \(X_\phi\) and reconstructs \(A_\phi X^{\mathrm{test}}\).

These are not the same information problem. Separate marginal PCA is a compression reference; dPCA must isolate a marginal from the full input.



For each positive grid value \(\lambda\), compute
\[
A_{\phi,\lambda}
=
X_\phi X^\top(XX^\top+\lambda I)^{-1}
\]
using a linear solve. Let \(u_{\phi,\lambda}\) be the leading left singular vector of \(A_{\phi,\lambda}X\). Set
\[
F_{\phi,\lambda}=u_{\phi,\lambda},
\qquad
D_{\phi,\lambda}=u_{\phi,\lambda}^\top A_{\phi,\lambda},
\]
and
\[
\widehat X_\phi=F_{\phi,\lambda}D_{\phi,\lambda}X.
\]
This is a deterministic ridge map followed by rank-one spectral truncation, a bounded reduced-rank regression construction consistent with the stable Method. Reduced-rank regression constrains the rank of a multivariate coefficient matrix; its encoder/decoder factorization is nonunique without a convention (Izenman 2008, sec. 6.3.2).



Decoding is a separate trial-level endpoint. Flatten each complete trial into \(24\times12=288\) features. For stimulus and decision separately:

fit feature mean and scale on training trials only;
fit ridge least-squares binary classifiers for the predeclared decoder grid;
select lambda by validation accuracy with smaller-lambda tie breaking; and
report untouched test accuracy and the 32-shuffle null distribution; the exactly balanced test labels make ordinary and balanced accuracy identical.

The classifier is not used to fit dPCA or choose its components. High decoding accuracy does not establish marginal reconstruction, statistical independence, causal relevance, or a unique representation.

title: Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
Empirical condition means and marginal contrasts. No learned projection; report sampling error and the visible label effects directly.
Time-only condition-mean baseline. Retain the training condition-independent time marginal and set label-dependent marginals to zero. This is not a full mean-only reconstruction.
Global rank-four PCA. Fit one unsupervised principal subspace to the complete training condition-mean tensor. Score combined reconstruction and the angle to the combined true signal span, not per-label component identity.
Separate rank-one marginal PCA. Fit one PCA to each supplied training marginal. This tests compressibility of the marginal but not isolation from the full tensor.
Regularized rank-one-per-marginal dPCA. Fit the declared ridge map plus SVD independently for time, stimulus, decision, and interaction. Select one shared dPCA lambda on validation means only.
Trial-level ridge decoding. Fit stimulus and decision classifiers independently of the dPCA objective and report as a separate endpoint.
Joint-label shuffle controls. Refit supervised condition means, dPCA candidates, lambda selection, and decoders from shuffled training labels.
Pseudo-population control. Preserve condition means while destroying simultaneous trial identity, then compare mean maps, noise covariance, and trial decoding.

No method is called an independent-component method, a causal decomposition, or a latent-state model.

title: Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
For applicable method \(m\) and marginal \(\phi\), report
\[
\operatorname{NMSE}_{m,\phi}
=
\frac{\lVert X_\phi^{\mathrm{test}}-widehat X_{m,\phi}^{\mathrm{test}}\rVert_F^2}
{\lVert X_\phi^{\mathrm{test}}\rVert_F^2}.
\]
A zero-energy denominator is a declared not-applicable boundary rather than replaced by a favorable constant. Report train, validation, and test separately where used.



For dPCA,
\[
\widehat X^{\mathrm{test}}=\sum_\phi
F_\phi D_\phi X^{\mathrm{test}}.
\]
Report normalized combined error against the centered held-out condition-mean tensor. Global PCA uses \(PX^{\mathrm{test}}\). Separate marginal PCA uses \(\sum_\phi P_\phi X_\phi^{\mathrm{test}}\) and is explicitly labelled as target-supplied marginal compression.



For balanced centered condition means,
\[
q_\phi=\frac{\lVert X_\phi\rVert_F^2}
{\sum_\psi\lVert X_\psi\rVert_F^2}.
\]
Report population-truth, train, validation, and test fractions. These describe the chosen equal-cell tensor and are not additive component variances across nonorthogonal dPCA axes.



For a unit estimated encoder \(\widehat f_\phi\) and true unit mixing direction \(a_\phi\), report the acute rank-one principal angle
\[
\theta_\phi=
\arccos\left(\left|\widehat f_\phi^\top a_\phi\right|\right).
\]
Apply this to separate marginal PCA encoders and dPCA encoders. Do not score dPCA decoder rows against \(a_\phi\). For global PCA, compare its complete rank-four subspace with
\[
\operatorname{span}(a_t,a_s,a_d,a_{sd})
\]
using all four principal angles and the projector Frobenius distance. In the nearly collinear condition, report conditioning and angle instability without pretending that two almost coincident directions are strongly practically identified.



For recovered marginal map \(A_\phi\) and each true or held-out source marginal \(X_\psi\), report all entries
\[
C_{\phi\leftarrow\psi}
=
\frac{\lVert A_\phi X_\psi\rVert_F^2}
{\sum_{\rho}\lVert A_\phi X_\rho\rVert_F^2}.
\]
Also report decoder-score profiles
\[
v_{\phi\leftarrow\psi}
=
\lVert D_\phi X_\psi\rVert_F^2.
\]
Rows and columns are explicitly labelled. The implementation stores raw map-output energy, the row-normalized confusion fraction \(C\), and decoder-score energy separately. It also reports an assigned_marginal_fraction equal to the diagonal confusion entry. A scalar demixing index
\[
\max_\psi v_{\phi\leftarrow\psi}/
\sum_\psi v_{\phi\leftarrow\psi}
\]
uses the maximum source fraction and may supplement but never replace the complete profile. It differs from the assigned fraction when an off-target source dominates, as in the nearly collinear decision control. Nonzero off-target entries mean cross-marginal sensitivity under this design, not causal mixing.



Report stimulus and decision test accuracy, selected decoder lambda, and the 32-shuffle median, interval, and exceedance count. Test labels are exactly balanced, so ordinary and balanced accuracy coincide and are not duplicated. Interaction decoding is omitted from the primary endpoint because four-way condition classification is a different multiclass task. Decoding results remain separate from marginal reconstruction tables.



For every dPCA grid value, report validation NMSE by marginal and their unweighted mean. Store the selected lambda and tie rule. Test metrics are computed once after selection and cannot change the choice.



Every metrics.csv row contains exactly:
split,condition,method,marginal,target,metric,value
Values are finite numeric. Inapplicable rows are omitted and explained in diagnostics.json; they are not encoded as zero or NaN. Missing-cell recovery rows contain the exact target prefix invalid_rank_deficient_balanced_recovery and cannot be pooled with valid recovery rows.

title: Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
The primary balanced condition tests recovery of a declared supervised mean decomposition. A small dPCA marginal reconstruction error means that one regularized linear map transfers from full training means to an independently estimated held-out marginal under the same labels and equal-cell measure. It does not imply that the labelled effect is statistically independent, uniquely represented, anatomically separate, causally generated by the label, or mechanistic.
Global PCA can preserve the combined signal span without assigning task semantics. Separate marginal PCA can recover a marginal direction after the marginal is supplied. dPCA addresses the harder isolation problem by using labels to define a target and fitting an oblique encoder/decoder map. Label supervision is part of the method, not external validation.






TipLDG synthesis



Demixing is relative to a declared label algebra, averaging measure, grouping convention, rank, regularization, and reconstruction loss. Changing any of those choices changes the estimand. A useful demixed display is therefore a reproducible supervised summary, not discovery of independent latent generators.

title: Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
It does not establish statistical independence among components or effects.
It does not establish causal separation, intervention effects, or mechanistic modules.
It does not prove that stimulus or decision labels are uniquely represented in the features.
It does not turn decoding accuracy into evidence of representation, necessity, or biological meaning.
It does not infer latent states, transition dynamics, a vector field, or an autonomous system.
It does not claim that smooth mean trajectories are dynamics; they are fixed time-indexed profiles plus trial averaging.
It does not prove manifold structure, topology, nonlinear geometry, or intrinsic dimension.
It does not identify a unique encoder/decoder factorization beyond the declared rank-one sign convention.
It does not make pseudo-population trials simultaneous observations.
It does not validate balanced marginalization when a factorial cell is missing.
It does not claim that mean-level reconstruction predicts single-trial performance.
It does not claim universal superiority of dPCA over PCA, marginal PCA, or decoding.

title: Label-Dependent Demixing
text:
A real-data analysis would need to define the true independent unit, simultaneity of recording, alignment events, binning/smoothing, feature scaling, label coding, missing cells, label correlations, cell weights, trial exclusions, sessions/subjects, and the grouping of interactions. Trial, session, or subject splits must prevent correlated observations from crossing folds.
If cells are missing, an explicit parametric model, scientifically justified weighting estimand, or redesigned experiment is required; balanced formulas cannot manufacture the absent contrast. If labels are correlated—such as stimulus and decision with few error trials—separate marginal interpretations depend on those rare cells and the chosen estimand. Pseudo-populations cannot estimate simultaneous noise correlations. Condition-mean dPCA should be supplemented by independent single-trial and session-level checks rather than backdating mean-map performance into trial-level claims.

The following sources were actually retrieved and inspected. Existing LDG Methods supplied terminology but were not treated as external evidence.

Machens (2010): the complete 10-page Frontiers article PDF was inspected for the abstract and introduction; the linear-mixture toy example; PCA covariance discussion; stimulus/decision marginalized covariance construction; extension to multiple task parameters; the marginal confusion matrix; overlap/nonseparability limitations; the distinction from blind source separation and independent-component assumptions; and the discussion. The appendix’s optimization derivations were not checked equation by equation. This source supports treating task-labelled covariance sources separately while rejecting an automatic statistical-independence interpretation (Machens 2010).
Brendel, Romo, and Machens (2011): the complete 9-page NeurIPS paper was inspected for the abstract and introduction; equations 1–7 defining PCA, factorial marginalized averages, exact reconstruction, and covariance decomposition; the demixing loss; the probabilistic orthogonality-constrained formulation; the algorithm summary; empirical illustration; and conclusion. The full EM algebra was not independently rederived line by line. This source supports the factorial marginalization ancestry and documents that the earlier formulation differs from the later reduced-rank method (Brendel et al. 2011).
Kobak et al. (2016): the 36-page eLife PDF was inspected for the abstract; introduction and conceptual PCA/LDA/dPCA comparison; the condition-mean encoder/decoder objective; grouped time/stimulus/decision/interaction decomposition; discussion and limitations; and Materials and methods sections covering balanced marginalization, reduced-rank regression, ridge regularization, rebalancing, pseudo-trials, cross-validation, decoding, and label shuffles. Dataset-specific result narratives and later method-comparison details were sampled rather than read exhaustively, and every supplementary derivation was not rederived. This source supports the bounded condition-mean objective, nonorthogonal axes, balancing requirement, held-out pseudo-trial principle, and separation of decoding from reconstruction (Kobak et al. 2016).
Izenman (2008): only Chapter 6 sections 6.3.1–6.3.2, printed pages 175–183, were inspected in the 758-page book. Inspection covered full-rank multivariate regression, the rank constraint, nonunique \(AB\) factorization, weighted least-squares criterion, spectral reduced-rank solution, sample estimators, and ridge perturbation for poorly conditioned covariance matrices. The rest of the book and rank-selection section 6.3.4 were not inspected for this object. This source supports the general reduced-rank-regression framing but not this Toy Model’s specific lambda grid or dPCA grouping (Izenman 2008, sec. 6.3.2).

title: Graph Geometry Recovery Without Manifold Overclaim
text:
This L1/stable Candidate B Toy Model separates finite graph construction, shortest-path distance, classical multidimensional scaling (MDS), affinity- operator eigenspaces, diffusion-distance truncation, and held-out extension. It uses two simulators with known scoring targets: a unit-speed hairpin with analytic arc length, and a clean sampled circle whose uniform Gaussian affinity is circulant. Numerical values are deterministic outputs under master seed 20260820; the corrected generated artifact contains 197 finite, uniquely keyed metrics.
Assumed background: Euclidean distance, connected weighted graphs, all-pairs shortest paths, symmetric eigendecomposition, classical MDS, reversible Markov operators, principal angles, and leakage-safe train/test evaluation.


The object asks two bounded questions.

Hairpin: when observations trace a known folded interval, does a fixed \(k\)-nearest-neighbor Isomap graph approximate analytic arc-length distance and support a useful one-dimensional held-out extension beyond PCA and ambient- distance MDS? How do a connector gap, nonuniform sampling, reduced branch separation, bad \(k\), and anisotropic feature scaling break that result?
Circle: for a finite clean uniform circle sample, does the declared \(\alpha=1\) Diffusion Maps operator recover the known first nonconstant two-dimensional Fourier eigenspace, how much diffusion distance is lost by retaining only two modes, and how accurately does normalized Nyström extension recover held-out midpoint angles? How do nonuniform density and extreme bandwidths change those finite-operator results?

The targets are declared simulator distances and finite graph/operator quantities. Graph success is not proof of topology, manifold structure, intrinsic dimension, geodesic or Riemannian geometry, unique coordinates, dynamics, mechanism, or causality.





Let
\[
r=0.175,
\qquad
L=6+\pi r=6.549778714378213.
\]
The two straight branches have length \(3\) and separation \(2r=0.35\). For true arc-length parameter \(\ell\in[0,L]\), define
\[
c_r(\ell)=
\begin{cases}
(0,\ell), & 0\leq\ell\leq3,\\[3pt]
\left(r+r\cos\theta,\ 3+r\sin\theta\right),
&3<\ell\leq3+\pi r,\\[3pt]
(2r,3-v), &3+\pi r<\ell\leq L,
\end{cases}
\]
where
\[
\theta=\pi-\frac{\ell-3}{r},
\qquad
v=\ell-(3+\pi r).
\]
The joins are continuous and \(\lVert c_r'(\ell)\rVert_2=1\) on the three smooth interiors. Therefore the simulator path distance is exactly
\[
d_\ell(i,j)=|\ell_i-\ell_j|.
\]
A fixed QR-derived isometry embeds the plane in \(\mathbb R^3\). NumPy QR is applied to
\[
A=
\begin{pmatrix}
1.0&0.3\\
-0.2&0.9\\
0.45&-0.35
\end{pmatrix},
\]
and the retained two columns are
\[
Q=
\begin{pmatrix}
-0.8971226080&-0.3267089443\\
0.1794245216&-0.8845629735\\
-0.4037051736& 0.3328807769
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad Q^\top Q=I_2.
\]
With fixed offset \(o=(0.4,-0.7,0.2)^\top\),
\[
x^0(\ell)=Qc_r(\ell)+o,
\qquad
x(\ell)=x^0(\ell)+\epsilon,
\qquad
\epsilon\sim\mathcal N(0,0.01^2I_3).
\]
The implementation retains \(\ell\) only for scoring and oracles. Graph fitting, PCA, MDS, and raw extension receive noisy observations only.



The circle uses 96 clean, uniformly spaced training angles and 96 held-out midpoint angles:
\[
\theta_j=\frac{2\pi j}{96},
\qquad
\theta_j^*=\frac{2\pi(j+1/2)}{96},
\qquad j=0,\ldots,95.
\]
Planar points \((\cos\theta,\sin\theta)\) are embedded isometrically in \(\mathbb R^3\) using the same \(Q\), without the hairpin offset. For training points, the Gaussian affinity is
\[
W_{ij}=\exp\left(-\frac{\lVert y_i-y_j\rVert_2^2}{\varepsilon}\right).
\]
Uniform circular spacing makes the clean distance and affinity matrices circulant. Hence
\[
\mathcal F_1
=\operatorname{span}\{(\cos\theta_j)_j,(\sin\theta_j)_j\}
\]
is the declared first nonconstant finite-operator eigenspace. The implementation checks circulant structure, eigenvalue ordering, subspace angles, and an operator residual rather than hard-coding recovery. This is a finite matrix oracle, not a topology inference result.






For nominal hairpin data, independently draw and sort
\[
\ell_i\sim\operatorname{Uniform}[0,L]
\]
within each split. Split sizes are:



Split
Rows
Use




train
180
graph, PCA, MDS, and scoring-alignment fit


validation
80
fixed-rule extension evaluation


test
80
final fixed-rule extension evaluation



Separate Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence(words))) streams generate train, validation, test, control, and observation-noise draws. Sorting is only a storage convention; no method receives row order as a path edge.



The nominal training and midpoint grids are deterministic. The nonuniform circle control draws 96 deterministic seeded values, sorts them, and applies
\[
\theta=2\pi u^{2.4},
\qquad u\sim\operatorname{Uniform}[0,1].
\]
There is no circle validation grid and no circle metric-rescaling condition.
Generation, feature transformation, graph/affinity construction, spectral fitting, extension, scoring alignment, artifact writing, and verification are separate functions. Test truth never enters a graph, operator, embedding, or raw extension.







dissimilarity: Euclidean distance in the supplied \(\mathbb R^3\) features;
nominal graph: undirected union \(k\)NN graph with \(k=6\);
neighbor candidates: set the distance diagonal to \(+\infty\) before stable mergesort, then retain the first \(k\) indices;
exact distance ties: stable sorting retains lower row indices first;
directed candidates are symmetrized by their union, with each retained edge assigned its exact ambient distance;
edge weight: ambient Euclidean distance;
shortest paths: deterministic vectorized Floyd–Warshall;
embedding dimension: one;
disconnected pairs: retain \(+\infty\) in diagnostics and do not pass them to classical MDS;
a long-arc-separation edge satisfies \[
|\ell_i-\ell_j|>0.70;
\]
a material path shortcut satisfies \[
|\ell_i-\ell_j|-w_{ij}>0.50,
\] where \(w_{ij}\) is the retained ambient edge weight; and
both rates use the number of unique undirected off-diagonal graph edges as their denominator.

Both edge labels use simulator truth only after graph construction. The long-arc label records separation without asserting underestimation; the term shortcut is reserved for the material path-underestimation criterion. No \(k\) is selected from \(\ell\), validation, or test results.



For finite distance matrix \(D\),
\[
J=I-\frac1n\mathbf1\mathbf1^\top,
\qquad
B=-\frac12JD^{\circ2}J.
\]
For the leading eigenpair \((\lambda_1,v_1)\), the one-dimensional coordinate is
\[
z=\sqrt{\max(\lambda_1,0)}v_1.
\]
The implementation reports two direct numerical diagnostics:
\[
\text{negative eigenmass}=\sum_{\lambda_j<0}|\lambda_j|
\]
and
\[
\text{strain}
=\sqrt{\operatorname{mean}\left(B-zz^\top\right)^2}.
\]
These are not normalized fractions.
For a held-out point with squared distances \(\delta_*^2\) to training points, the implemented Gower extension forms
\[
b_*
=-\frac12\left[
\delta_*^2
-\operatorname{mean}(\delta_*^2)\mathbf1
-\operatorname{rowmean}(D^{\circ2})
+\operatorname{mean}(D^{\circ2})\mathbf1
\right]
\]
and returns
\[
z_*=\frac{b_*^\top v_1}{\sqrt{\max(\lambda_1,10^{-15})}}.
\]
Ambient MDS uses \(\delta_{*j}=\lVert x_*-x_j\rVert_2\). Isomap attaches the new point to its six nearest training vertices without changing the training graph, then uses
\[
\delta_{*j}
=\min_{i\in N_6(x_*)}
\left(\lVert x_*-x_i\rVert_2+d_G(i,j)\right).
\]



For each of PCA, ambient MDS, and Isomap, fit
\[
\ell_i=az_i+b
\]
by least squares on training coordinates and training \(\ell\). Freeze \((a,b)\) and apply it unchanged to validation and test raw coordinates. The affine map handles sign, origin, and scale only for scoring; it is not part of the observation-only fit and does not identify a unique latent coordinate.



The fixed nominal parameters are
\[
\varepsilon=0.18,
\qquad
\alpha=1,
\qquad
t=1,
\qquad
m=2.
\]
Self-affinities are retained. Define
\[
q_i=\sum_jW_{ij},
\qquad
K_{ij}=\frac{W_{ij}}{q_iq_j},
\qquad
d_i=\sum_jK_{ij},
\]
\[
P=D^{-1}K,
\qquad
\pi_i=\frac{d_i}{\sum_rd_r},
\qquad
S=D^{-1/2}KD^{-1/2}.
\]
Diagonalize the real symmetric \(S\) with Euclidean-orthonormal eigenvectors \(\phi_l\). The implementation transforms them to right eigenfunctions
\[
\psi_l
=\sqrt{\sum_i d_i}\,D^{-1/2}\phi_l,
\]
so
\[
\psi_l^\top\Pi\psi_m=\delta_{lm}.
\]
The two-mode coordinate excludes the trivial constant mode:
\[
\Phi_{1,2}(y_i)
=\left(\lambda_1\psi_1(i),\lambda_2\psi_2(i)\right).
\]
The full finite-operator diffusion distance uses all nonconstant modes,
\[
D_1(i,j)^2
=\sum_{l=1}^{95}\lambda_l^2
\left(\psi_l(i)-\psi_l(j)\right)^2,
\]
and is independently recomputed from rows of \(P\) as
\[
D_1(i,j)^2
=\sum_k\frac{(P_{ik}-P_{jk})^2}{\pi_k}.
\]
Diffusion time is one graph-operator step, not physical time or discovered dynamics (Coifman and Lafon 2006).



For held-out \(y_*\), compute training affinities and
\[
q_*=\sum_jw_{*j},
\qquad
k_{*j}=\frac{w_{*j}}{q_*q_j},
\qquad
p_{*j}=\frac{k_{*j}}{\sum_rk_{*r}}.
\]
For nonzero modes,
\[
\psi_l(y_*)
=\frac1{\lambda_l}\sum_jp_{*j}\psi_l(j).
\]
The two retained coordinates are linearly aligned to training rows \((\cos\theta_i,\sin\theta_i)\) by one unconstrained least-squares \(2\times2\) map. That same map scores all midpoint extensions. There is no second Procrustes, radial, angular, or validation alignment in the implementation. Spectral out-of-sample extension is an additional algorithm and need not equal a transductive full refit (Bengio et al. 2003).






Fit the training mean, rank-one PCA, ambient-distance MDS, and \(k=6\) Isomap on noisy training observations. Extend validation and test observations without rebuilding the graph.



The implemented controls are exact and predeclared:

Sparse connector gap: rejection-sample 180 training \(\ell\) values outside \[
[3-0.18,\ 3+\pi r+0.18].
\]
Reduced branch separation: set \[
r_r=0.06,
\qquad
L_r=6+\pi r_r=6.188495559215387,
\] and preserve the nominal training quantiles by \[
\ell_r=\frac{\ell_{\mathrm{nominal}}}{L}\,L_r.
\] Evaluate the same piecewise formula \(c_{r_r}\) on \([0,L_r]\) and use \(k=6\). This retains two straight branches of length 3 and endpoint \(c_{r_r}(L_r)=(0.12,0)\).
Nonuniform sampling: draw \(u\sim U[0,1]\) and transform \[
\ell=
\begin{cases}
L\,0.55(u/0.65)^2,&u<0.65,\\
L\left[0.55+0.45((u-0.65)/0.35)^{0.55}\right],&u\geq0.65.
\end{cases}
\]
Disconnected small neighborhood: nominal observations with union \(k=1\).
Wrong larger neighborhood: nominal observations with union \(k=18\).
Nearly complete graph: nominal observations with \(k=n_{\mathrm{train}}-2=178\).
Anisotropic feature scaling: right-multiply nominal observed rows by \[
\operatorname{diag}(1,1,3)
\] before distance and graph construction, then keep \(k=6\). This changes feature geometry and neighbor identities; it is not a harmless global scalar.





Uniform nominal: 96 clean training angles, \(\varepsilon=0.18\).
Nonuniform density: seeded sorted \(2\pi u^{2.4}\) angles, \(\varepsilon=0.18\).
Bandwidth too small: uniform angles with \(\varepsilon=0.005\).
Bandwidth too large: uniform angles with \(\varepsilon=5.0\).

Failures are reported rather than tuned away. There is no circle metric-rescaling condition.




The single generated summary.png has exactly four panels:

nominal noisy hairpin training points and fixed \(k=6\) graph edges;
nominal test true \(\ell\) against train-aligned PCA, ambient-MDS, and Isomap coordinates;
the nominal circle’s first two nonconstant diffusion eigenfunctions; and
selected numerical controls plus the interpretation boundary.




Graph geometry recovery diagnostic


The figure does not draw the sparse-gap, reduced-separation, nonuniform, or bandwidth controls. It is diagnostic only; truth ordering and alignment are scoring/display aids rather than fitting inputs.




The hairpin is unit-speed and the fixed \(Q\) is isometric, so noiseless path distance is exactly \(|\Delta\ell|\).
PCA and ambient-distance classical MDS should recover equivalent training one-dimensional sample coordinate subspaces for Euclidean distances. This is an implementation oracle, not a path-distance result.
A connected local graph without cross-branch edges can approximate analytic arc length better than ambient chords. Isomap separates graph construction, shortest paths, and MDS (Tenenbaum et al. 2000).
A sparse gap or \(k=1\) can disconnect the graph. Reduced separation, \(k=18\), or \(k=178\) can create material path shortcuts. Graph approximation depends on sampling, separation, curvature, and path conditions (Bernstein et al. 2000).
On the clean uniform circle, circulant affinity makes the cosine/sine span an exact finite-operator target up to floating point and basis rotation.
Two modes need not reproduce full finite-operator diffusion distance even when their eigenspace is recovered exactly.
Nonuniform density and extreme bandwidths change degrees, spectra, diffusion scale, truncation, and finite-sample eigenspaces. The \(\alpha=1\) continuum interpretation remains assumption-dependent rather than a finite guarantee (Coifman and Lafon 2006).

The empirical result, including contrary behavior, is retained without tuning.

The nominal hairpin graph closely approximated this simulator’s arc-length distance and its frozen Isomap extension retained low RMSE on independent validation and test samples. PCA and ambient MDS were equivalent linear/chord baselines and had much larger aligned coordinate error. The negative controls show that this result depended on connector coverage, branch separation, neighborhood size, sampling density, and feature metric.
The uniform circle supplied an algebraic finite-operator oracle: its first nonconstant right-eigenfunction eigenspace matched the cosine/sine span in the \(L^2(\pi)\) representation, and midpoint Nyström extension was accurate to floating-point precision. Nevertheless, two modes omitted substantial full diffusion-distance content at \(\varepsilon=0.18\). Nonuniform density rotated the finite leading eigenspace away from the uniform Fourier target, while extreme bandwidths changed the spectrum and diffusion scale even when circulant symmetry preserved the Fourier axes.
Graph shortest paths remain finite combinatorial distances, not automatically smooth geodesics. Train-fitted alignments change only scoring coordinates and do not identify scientifically privileged axes.






WarningWhat this does NOT imply



Accurate graph distances, low MDS strain, Fourier-eigenspace recovery, a circular plot, or low held-out extension error does not prove topology, manifold structure, intrinsic dimension, geodesic or Riemannian recovery, unique coordinates, dynamics, mechanism, causality, or biological validity.






It does not prove that unknown data are sampled from a manifold.
It does not recover interval or circle topology from real data.
It does not estimate model-free intrinsic dimension.
It does not make graph shortest paths smooth or globally minimizing geodesics.
It does not estimate a Riemannian metric tensor, curvature, tangent spaces, or an atlas.
It does not make graph connectivity evidence for connected latent topology.
It does not make a repeated eigenspace two unique coordinates.
It does not make diffusion time physical time.
It does not discover dynamics, a vector field, transition law, mechanism, or causal structure.
It does not establish universal superiority of Isomap or Diffusion Maps.
It does not guarantee equality between frozen extension and transductive refit.




Real-data graph geometry requires an independently justified observational unit, feature representation, scaling, missing-data policy, distance, neighborhood or bandwidth, density normalization, component policy, coordinate count, and out-of-sample use. Dependence units such as subjects, sessions, trials, or trajectories should be split intact. Building one graph on train and test is transductive and cannot be reported as held-out deployment.
Before interpreting coordinates, report neighbor examples, components, edge and degree distributions, negative eigenstructure, spectral stability, truncation, and metric/hyperparameter sensitivity. Without simulator truth, graph quality requires external scientific justification, stability, or held-out tasks rather than a compelling visualization.

title: Graph Geometry Recovery Without Manifold Overclaim
text:
The object asks two bounded questions.

Hairpin: when observations trace a known folded interval, does a fixed \(k\)-nearest-neighbor Isomap graph approximate analytic arc-length distance and support a useful one-dimensional held-out extension beyond PCA and ambient- distance MDS? How do a connector gap, nonuniform sampling, reduced branch separation, bad \(k\), and anisotropic feature scaling break that result?
Circle: for a finite clean uniform circle sample, does the declared \(\alpha=1\) Diffusion Maps operator recover the known first nonconstant two-dimensional Fourier eigenspace, how much diffusion distance is lost by retaining only two modes, and how accurately does normalized Nyström extension recover held-out midpoint angles? How do nonuniform density and extreme bandwidths change those finite-operator results?

The targets are declared simulator distances and finite graph/operator quantities. Graph success is not proof of topology, manifold structure, intrinsic dimension, geodesic or Riemannian geometry, unique coordinates, dynamics, mechanism, or causality.

title: Graph Geometry Recovery Without Manifold Overclaim
text:
Let
\[
r=0.175,
\qquad
L=6+\pi r=6.549778714378213.
\]
The two straight branches have length \(3\) and separation \(2r=0.35\). For true arc-length parameter \(\ell\in[0,L]\), define
\[
c_r(\ell)=
\begin{cases}
(0,\ell), & 0\leq\ell\leq3,\\[3pt]
\left(r+r\cos\theta,\ 3+r\sin\theta\right),
&3<\ell\leq3+\pi r,\\[3pt]
(2r,3-v), &3+\pi r<\ell\leq L,
\end{cases}
\]
where
\[
\theta=\pi-\frac{\ell-3}{r},
\qquad
v=\ell-(3+\pi r).
\]
The joins are continuous and \(\lVert c_r'(\ell)\rVert_2=1\) on the three smooth interiors. Therefore the simulator path distance is exactly
\[
d_\ell(i,j)=|\ell_i-\ell_j|.
\]
A fixed QR-derived isometry embeds the plane in \(\mathbb R^3\). NumPy QR is applied to
\[
A=
\begin{pmatrix}
1.0&0.3\\
-0.2&0.9\\
0.45&-0.35
\end{pmatrix},
\]
and the retained two columns are
\[
Q=
\begin{pmatrix}
-0.8971226080&-0.3267089443\\
0.1794245216&-0.8845629735\\
-0.4037051736& 0.3328807769
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad Q^\top Q=I_2.
\]
With fixed offset \(o=(0.4,-0.7,0.2)^\top\),
\[
x^0(\ell)=Qc_r(\ell)+o,
\qquad
x(\ell)=x^0(\ell)+\epsilon,
\qquad
\epsilon\sim\mathcal N(0,0.01^2I_3).
\]
The implementation retains \(\ell\) only for scoring and oracles. Graph fitting, PCA, MDS, and raw extension receive noisy observations only.



The circle uses 96 clean, uniformly spaced training angles and 96 held-out midpoint angles:
\[
\theta_j=\frac{2\pi j}{96},
\qquad
\theta_j^*=\frac{2\pi(j+1/2)}{96},
\qquad j=0,\ldots,95.
\]
Planar points \((\cos\theta,\sin\theta)\) are embedded isometrically in \(\mathbb R^3\) using the same \(Q\), without the hairpin offset. For training points, the Gaussian affinity is
\[
W_{ij}=\exp\left(-\frac{\lVert y_i-y_j\rVert_2^2}{\varepsilon}\right).
\]
Uniform circular spacing makes the clean distance and affinity matrices circulant. Hence
\[
\mathcal F_1
=\operatorname{span}\{(\cos\theta_j)_j,(\sin\theta_j)_j\}
\]
is the declared first nonconstant finite-operator eigenspace. The implementation checks circulant structure, eigenvalue ordering, subspace angles, and an operator residual rather than hard-coding recovery. This is a finite matrix oracle, not a topology inference result.

title: Graph Geometry Recovery Without Manifold Overclaim
text:
dissimilarity: Euclidean distance in the supplied \(\mathbb R^3\) features;
nominal graph: undirected union \(k\)NN graph with \(k=6\);
neighbor candidates: set the distance diagonal to \(+\infty\) before stable mergesort, then retain the first \(k\) indices;
exact distance ties: stable sorting retains lower row indices first;
directed candidates are symmetrized by their union, with each retained edge assigned its exact ambient distance;
edge weight: ambient Euclidean distance;
shortest paths: deterministic vectorized Floyd–Warshall;
embedding dimension: one;
disconnected pairs: retain \(+\infty\) in diagnostics and do not pass them to classical MDS;
a long-arc-separation edge satisfies \[
|\ell_i-\ell_j|>0.70;
\]
a material path shortcut satisfies \[
|\ell_i-\ell_j|-w_{ij}>0.50,
\] where \(w_{ij}\) is the retained ambient edge weight; and
both rates use the number of unique undirected off-diagonal graph edges as their denominator.

Both edge labels use simulator truth only after graph construction. The long-arc label records separation without asserting underestimation; the term shortcut is reserved for the material path-underestimation criterion. No \(k\) is selected from \(\ell\), validation, or test results.



For finite distance matrix \(D\),
\[
J=I-\frac1n\mathbf1\mathbf1^\top,
\qquad
B=-\frac12JD^{\circ2}J.
\]
For the leading eigenpair \((\lambda_1,v_1)\), the one-dimensional coordinate is
\[
z=\sqrt{\max(\lambda_1,0)}v_1.
\]
The implementation reports two direct numerical diagnostics:
\[
\text{negative eigenmass}=\sum_{\lambda_j<0}|\lambda_j|
\]
and
\[
\text{strain}
=\sqrt{\operatorname{mean}\left(B-zz^\top\right)^2}.
\]
These are not normalized fractions.
For a held-out point with squared distances \(\delta_*^2\) to training points, the implemented Gower extension forms
\[
b_*
=-\frac12\left[
\delta_*^2
-\operatorname{mean}(\delta_*^2)\mathbf1
-\operatorname{rowmean}(D^{\circ2})
+\operatorname{mean}(D^{\circ2})\mathbf1
\right]
\]
and returns
\[
z_*=\frac{b_*^\top v_1}{\sqrt{\max(\lambda_1,10^{-15})}}.
\]
Ambient MDS uses \(\delta_{*j}=\lVert x_*-x_j\rVert_2\). Isomap attaches the new point to its six nearest training vertices without changing the training graph, then uses
\[
\delta_{*j}
=\min_{i\in N_6(x_*)}
\left(\lVert x_*-x_i\rVert_2+d_G(i,j)\right).
\]



For each of PCA, ambient MDS, and Isomap, fit
\[
\ell_i=az_i+b
\]
by least squares on training coordinates and training \(\ell\). Freeze \((a,b)\) and apply it unchanged to validation and test raw coordinates. The affine map handles sign, origin, and scale only for scoring; it is not part of the observation-only fit and does not identify a unique latent coordinate.



The fixed nominal parameters are
\[
\varepsilon=0.18,
\qquad
\alpha=1,
\qquad
t=1,
\qquad
m=2.
\]
Self-affinities are retained. Define
\[
q_i=\sum_jW_{ij},
\qquad
K_{ij}=\frac{W_{ij}}{q_iq_j},
\qquad
d_i=\sum_jK_{ij},
\]
\[
P=D^{-1}K,
\qquad
\pi_i=\frac{d_i}{\sum_rd_r},
\qquad
S=D^{-1/2}KD^{-1/2}.
\]
Diagonalize the real symmetric \(S\) with Euclidean-orthonormal eigenvectors \(\phi_l\). The implementation transforms them to right eigenfunctions
\[
\psi_l
=\sqrt{\sum_i d_i}\,D^{-1/2}\phi_l,
\]
so
\[
\psi_l^\top\Pi\psi_m=\delta_{lm}.
\]
The two-mode coordinate excludes the trivial constant mode:
\[
\Phi_{1,2}(y_i)
=\left(\lambda_1\psi_1(i),\lambda_2\psi_2(i)\right).
\]
The full finite-operator diffusion distance uses all nonconstant modes,
\[
D_1(i,j)^2
=\sum_{l=1}^{95}\lambda_l^2
\left(\psi_l(i)-\psi_l(j)\right)^2,
\]
and is independently recomputed from rows of \(P\) as
\[
D_1(i,j)^2
=\sum_k\frac{(P_{ik}-P_{jk})^2}{\pi_k}.
\]
Diffusion time is one graph-operator step, not physical time or discovered dynamics (Coifman and Lafon 2006).



For held-out \(y_*\), compute training affinities and
\[
q_*=\sum_jw_{*j},
\qquad
k_{*j}=\frac{w_{*j}}{q_*q_j},
\qquad
p_{*j}=\frac{k_{*j}}{\sum_rk_{*r}}.
\]
For nonzero modes,
\[
\psi_l(y_*)
=\frac1{\lambda_l}\sum_jp_{*j}\psi_l(j).
\]
The two retained coordinates are linearly aligned to training rows \((\cos\theta_i,\sin\theta_i)\) by one unconstrained least-squares \(2\times2\) map. That same map scores all midpoint extensions. There is no second Procrustes, radial, angular, or validation alignment in the implementation. Spectral out-of-sample extension is an additional algorithm and need not equal a transductive full refit (Bengio et al. 2003).

title: Graph Geometry Recovery Without Manifold Overclaim
text:
Fit the training mean, rank-one PCA, ambient-distance MDS, and \(k=6\) Isomap on noisy training observations. Extend validation and test observations without rebuilding the graph.



The implemented controls are exact and predeclared:

Sparse connector gap: rejection-sample 180 training \(\ell\) values outside \[
[3-0.18,\ 3+\pi r+0.18].
\]
Reduced branch separation: set \[
r_r=0.06,
\qquad
L_r=6+\pi r_r=6.188495559215387,
\] and preserve the nominal training quantiles by \[
\ell_r=\frac{\ell_{\mathrm{nominal}}}{L}\,L_r.
\] Evaluate the same piecewise formula \(c_{r_r}\) on \([0,L_r]\) and use \(k=6\). This retains two straight branches of length 3 and endpoint \(c_{r_r}(L_r)=(0.12,0)\).
Nonuniform sampling: draw \(u\sim U[0,1]\) and transform \[
\ell=

title: Graph Geometry Recovery Without Manifold Overclaim
text:
The nominal hairpin graph closely approximated this simulator’s arc-length distance and its frozen Isomap extension retained low RMSE on independent validation and test samples. PCA and ambient MDS were equivalent linear/chord baselines and had much larger aligned coordinate error. The negative controls show that this result depended on connector coverage, branch separation, neighborhood size, sampling density, and feature metric.
The uniform circle supplied an algebraic finite-operator oracle: its first nonconstant right-eigenfunction eigenspace matched the cosine/sine span in the \(L^2(\pi)\) representation, and midpoint Nyström extension was accurate to floating-point precision. Nevertheless, two modes omitted substantial full diffusion-distance content at \(\varepsilon=0.18\). Nonuniform density rotated the finite leading eigenspace away from the uniform Fourier target, while extreme bandwidths changed the spectrum and diffusion scale even when circulant symmetry preserved the Fourier axes.
Graph shortest paths remain finite combinatorial distances, not automatically smooth geodesics. Train-fitted alignments change only scoring coordinates and do not identify scientifically privileged axes.






WarningWhat this does NOT imply



Accurate graph distances, low MDS strain, Fourier-eigenspace recovery, a circular plot, or low held-out extension error does not prove topology, manifold structure, intrinsic dimension, geodesic or Riemannian recovery, unique coordinates, dynamics, mechanism, causality, or biological validity.

title: Graph Geometry Recovery Without Manifold Overclaim
text:
It does not prove that unknown data are sampled from a manifold.
It does not recover interval or circle topology from real data.
It does not estimate model-free intrinsic dimension.
It does not make graph shortest paths smooth or globally minimizing geodesics.
It does not estimate a Riemannian metric tensor, curvature, tangent spaces, or an atlas.
It does not make graph connectivity evidence for connected latent topology.
It does not make a repeated eigenspace two unique coordinates.
It does not make diffusion time physical time.
It does not discover dynamics, a vector field, transition law, mechanism, or causal structure.
It does not establish universal superiority of Isomap or Diffusion Maps.
It does not guarantee equality between frozen extension and transductive refit.

title: Graph Geometry Recovery Without Manifold Overclaim
text:
Real-data graph geometry requires an independently justified observational unit, feature representation, scaling, missing-data policy, distance, neighborhood or bandwidth, density normalization, component policy, coordinate count, and out-of-sample use. Dependence units such as subjects, sessions, trials, or trajectories should be split intact. Building one graph on train and test is transductive and cannot be reported as held-out deployment.
Before interpreting coordinates, report neighbor examples, components, edge and degree distributions, negative eigenstructure, spectral stability, truncation, and metric/hyperparameter sensitivity. Without simulator truth, graph quality requires external scientific justification, stability, or held-out tasks rather than a compelling visualization.

title: Bounded Nonlinear Reconstruction
text:
This L1/stable Candidate G Toy Model asks whether one fixed small nonlinear autoencoder improves held-out reconstruction over rank-matched linear methods on a known curved simulator, while controls expose full-dimensional data, nuisance variance, finite-sample capacity, and extrapolation. Numerical values are deterministic outputs under master seed 20260819; they are conditional on the declared architecture, optimizer, preprocessing, splits, and loss.
Assumed background: centered/scaled PCA, deterministic feed-forward networks, reverse-mode differentiation, full-batch Adam, and leakage-safe train/validation/test evaluation.


For observations generated from one scalar through a fixed curved map into six features:

does a one-coordinate nonlinear bottleneck improve held-out MSE over the training mean, rank-one PCA, and a trained linear autoencoder in the identical standardized metric;
does learning the encoder improve on a frozen random nonlinear encoder with a trained decoder;
are reconstruction, code activity, and checkpoint choice stable across five predeclared seeds;
how do results change for full-dimensional Gaussian data, independent high-variance nuisance features, few samples with a larger architecture, and shifted test support; and
which conclusions remain strictly about reconstruction rather than manifold structure, intrinsic dimension, unique coordinates, representation, or mechanism?




The ambient dimension is \(p=6\) and the scoring-only parameter is \(s\). For curved conditions,
\[
g(s)=
\begin{pmatrix}
s\\ s^2\\0.35\sin(2s)\\0.2s^3\\\cos(s)-\sin(1.5)/1.5\\0.4\sin(3s)
\end{pmatrix},
\]
and
\[
x=g(s)+\epsilon,\qquad \epsilon\sim\mathcal N(0,0.06^2I_6).
\]
Nominal train, validation, and test values use \(s\sim\operatorname{Uniform}[-1.5,1.5]\). The shifted-range test draws both signs with \(|s|\sim\operatorname{Uniform}[1.5,2.4]\), while its train and validation samples remain in range. The implementation retains \(s\) and \(g(s)\) for simulation scoring only; neither is a training target.
The full-dimensional control draws from a full-rank Gaussian whose population mean and covariance exactly match the nominal curved observable distribution, including \(0.06^2I_6\) noise. A fixed 256-node Gauss–Legendre rule on \([-1.5,1.5]\) computes those moments. The resulting covariance eigenvalues are approximately
\[
(0.85225,0.53472,0.10844,0.00563,0.00378,0.00360),
\]
so the Gaussian remains full rank while having no scalar generator truth. Executable target-moment discrepancies are zero; finite sampled splits are permitted ordinary sampling deviations. A one-dimensional bottleneck applied to this condition is imposed compression, not a dimension estimate.

title: Bounded Nonlinear Reconstruction
Bounded Nonlinear Reconstruction
text:
The ambient dimension is \(p=6\) and the scoring-only parameter is \(s\). For curved conditions,
\[
g(s)=
\begin{pmatrix}
s\\ s^2\\0.35\sin(2s)\\0.2s^3\\\cos(s)-\sin(1.5)/1.5\\0.4\sin(3s)
\end{pmatrix},
\]
and
\[
x=g(s)+\epsilon,\qquad \epsilon\sim\mathcal N(0,0.06^2I_6).
\]
Nominal train, validation, and test values use \(s\sim\operatorname{Uniform}[-1.5,1.5]\). The shifted-range test draws both signs with \(|s|\sim\operatorname{Uniform}[1.5,2.4]\), while its train and validation samples remain in range. The implementation retains \(s\) and \(g(s)\) for simulation scoring only; neither is a training target.
The full-dimensional control draws from a full-rank Gaussian whose population mean and covariance exactly match the nominal curved observable distribution, including \(0.06^2I_6\) noise. A fixed 256-node Gauss–Legendre rule on \([-1.5,1.5]\) computes those moments. The resulting covariance eigenvalues are approximately
\[
(0.85225,0.53472,0.10844,0.00563,0.00378,0.00360),
\]
so the Gaussian remains full rank while having no scalar generator truth. Executable target-moment discrepancies are zero; finite sampled splits are permitted ordinary sampling deviations. A one-dimensional bottleneck applied to this condition is imposed compression, not a dimension estimate.

title: Bounded Nonlinear Reconstruction
text:
Rank-one PCA is the analytic linear reconstruction reference. A well-trained linear AE should approach its reconstructed subspace and loss (Bourlard and Kamp 1988; Baldi and Hornik 1989).
A small nonlinear AE can improve interpolation on the curved generator without proving that an arbitrary dataset is one-dimensional or manifold-valued.
Frozen random nonlinear features can reconstruct some structure, so their full seed distribution is necessary before crediting learned encoding.
Full-dimensional Gaussian data provide no valid scalar-generator recovery claim even if a flexible model improves MSE.
Standardization can prevent nuisance features from dominating the optimized metric while original-unit error remains nuisance-dominated.
Out-of-range reconstruction and code ordering may degrade sharply despite good in-range validation.
A larger network with few samples can overfit, but predeclared validation stopping may also prevent the intended dramatic failure. Negative controls are reported, not tuned to guarantee a story.

title: 一阶自治动力系统
text:
六个 Cycle 1 概念区分 state、其 state space、trajectory、initial condition、vector field 与 flow。本数学对象把这些角色连接在一个可复用连续时间表述中：
\[
\frac{dx}{dt}=f(x),
\qquad
x(t_0)=x_0.
\]
微分方程不只是绘制曲线的紧凑描述。它是对未知可微状态轨迹的约束。存在性、唯一性、延拓与有限时间流陈述需要单独假设。在后续 LDG 工作可以把自治 ODE 用作生成模型或恢复目标之前，使这些假设显式是必要的。
范围刻意很窄：\(\mathcal{X}\) 是 \(\mathbb{R}^n\) 的开子集，时间是连续的，规则是确定性与自治的。离散时间、随机、输入驱动、显式时间相关与非欧氏系统在本对象之外。




State：模型在一个时间携带的状态值。
State Space：该状态的可取值。
Trajectory：一条以时间为参数的演化。
Initial Condition：赋值 \(x(t_0)=x_0\)。
Vector Field：瞬时状态变化规则。
Flow：跨受支持初始状态的有限时间演化。

假定背景： 初等集合、函数、欧氏向量、单变量微分与积分、链式法则与函数复合。





设
\[
\mathcal{X}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n
\]
是开的，并设
\[
f:\mathcal{X}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^n.
\]
方程
\[
\dot{x}=f(x)
\]
是一阶自治常微分方程。它是一阶的，因为最高阶导数是 \(\dot{x}\)；它是自治的，因为右侧依赖当前状态 \(x\) 而不显式依赖时钟时间 \(t\)。
区间 \(I\subseteq\mathbb{R}\) 上的解是可微曲线
\[
x:I\rightarrow\mathcal{X}
\]
使得对每个 \(t\in I\)，
\[
\dot{x}(t)=f\bigl(x(t)\bigr).
\]
因此 \(x(t)\) 是 \(\mathcal{X}\) 中的状态值，而 \(\dot{x}(t)\) 与 \(f(x(t))\) 都是 \(\mathbb{R}^n\) 中的向量。方程要求轨迹在每个访问状态与 \(f\) 赋予的向量相切。



对参考时间 \(t_0\) 与初始状态 \(x_0\in\mathcal{X}\)，初值问题（IVP）是
\[
\dot{x}=f(x),
\qquad
x(t_0)=x_0.
\]
IVP 的解必须同时满足微分方程与初始条件。规则 \(f\) 描述其定义域上可能的瞬时演化；初始条件选择在 \(t_0\) 穿过 \(x_0\) 的解或解集。




局部解定义在包含 \(t_0\) 的开区间 \(I\) 上。
如果解不能延拓到严格更大区间同时保持为 \(\mathcal{X}\) 中的解，则它是极大的。如果 IVP 承认唯一局部解——即局部解存在且任何两个兼容局部解在其公共定义域上一致——那些局部片段组装成开极大区间
\[
I_{t_0,x_0}=(T_-(t_0,x_0),T_+(t_0,x_0)).
\]
上的唯一极大解。
本对象全时设定中的全局解对每个 \(t\in\mathbb{R}\) 有定义，因此其极大区间是 \(\mathbb{R}\)。

局部存在性与唯一性不蕴含全局存在性。在相同局部可解性假设下，如果极大解具有有限前向端点 \(T_+\)，则当 \(t\uparrow T_+\) 时它最终离开 \(\mathcal{X}\) 的每个紧子集。当 \(\mathcal{X}=\mathbb{R}^n\) 时，这意味着 \(\|x(t)\|\to\infty\)。在真开域上，轨迹可以保持有界同时接近 \(\mathcal{X}\) 的补集；它不必收敛到某个特定边界点。类似陈述在有限后向端点成立。Teschl 把局部可解性与极大延拓分开，并明确陈述该紧集准则 (Teschl 2012年, secs. 2.2, 2.6)。



从初始条件度量时间是有用的。把
\[
\tau=t-t_0
\]
写为经过时间。对每个 \(x\in\mathcal{X}\)，假设在经过时间 0 穿过 \(x\) 的唯一极大解定义在包含 \(0\) 的区间 \(I_x\) 上。定义
\[
W=\{(\tau,x)\in\mathbb{R}\times\mathcal{X}:\tau\in I_x\}.
\]
集合 \(W\) 记录哪些经过时间/状态对受支持。它不必等于 \(\mathbb{R}\times\mathcal{X}\)：状态可以只支持有限的前向或后向演化区间。对固定经过时间 \(\tau\)，有限时间映射具有类型化定义域
\[
\operatorname{dom}(\phi_\tau)
=
\{x\in\mathcal{X}:(\tau,x)\in W\}.
\]


在局部存在性与唯一性下，极大解定义单值映射
\[
\Phi:W\rightarrow\mathcal{X},
\qquad
(\tau,x)\mapsto\Phi(\tau,x)=\phi_\tau(x).
\]
该局部演化族满足
\[
\phi_0(x)=x
\]
且只要各项有定义，
\[
\phi_{\tau+s}(x)=\phi_\tau\bigl(\phi_s(x)\bigr).
\]
更显式地，如果 \(s\in I_x\) 且 \(\tau\in I_{\phi_s(x)}\)，则 \(s+\tau\in I_x\)，且先演化 \(s\) 再演化 \(\tau\) 与演化组合经过时间 \(s+\tau\) 一致。这些代数性质来自自治性与唯一性。它们本身不断言在 \((\tau,x)\) 上的联合连续性或可微性。
当 \(f\) 局部利普希茨时它是连续的，因此每条单个曲线 \(\tau\mapsto\phi_\tau(x)\) 对经过时间 \(C^1\) 且满足
\[
\frac{d}{d\tau}\phi_\tau(x)
=
f\bigl(\phi_\tau(x)\bigr).
\]
特别地，
\[
\left.\frac{d}{d\tau}\phi_\tau(x)\right|_{\tau=0}
=
f(x).
\]
这是沿一条轨迹对 \(\tau\) 的可微性；它尚不是对初始状态 \(x\) 可微性的主张。



如果 \(f\in C^1(\mathcal{X},\mathbb{R}^n)\)，Teschl 的光滑依赖结果给出 \(W\) 是开的，且联合映射
\[
\Phi:W\rightarrow\mathcal{X},
\qquad
(\tau,x)\mapsto\Phi(\tau,x)=\phi_\tau(x),
\]
对经过时间与初始状态联合 \(C^1\)。在采用的 LDG 约定下，这个联合 \(C^1\) 映射连同上述恒等与复合律是 \(f\) 生成的局部流。更一般地，\(f\in C^k\) 且 \(k\geq1\) 给出联合 \(C^k\) 局部流映射 (Teschl 2012年, sec. 6.2)。












符号
角色




\(\mathcal{X}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n\)
开欧氏状态空间域。


\(x\in\mathcal{X}\)
一个可取状态值。


\(x(t)\)
一条轨迹上时钟时间 \(t\) 的状态值。


\(t_0\)
IVP 的参考时钟时间。


\(x_0\)
满足 \(x(t_0)=x_0\) 的初始状态。


\(f:\mathcal{X}\to\mathbb{R}^n\)
自治向量场。


\(\dot{x}(t)\)
轨迹的瞬时导数。


\(I_{t_0,x_0}\)
穿过 \((t_0,x_0)\) 的解的极大时钟时间区间。


\(\tau=t-t_0\)
相对参考时间的经过时间。


\(I_x\)
在 \(\tau=0\) 穿过 \(x\) 的解的极大经过时间区间。


\(W\)
受支持的经过时间/状态对 \((\tau,x)\)。


\(\operatorname{dom}(\phi_\tau)\)
满足 \((\tau,x)\in W\) 的状态 \(x\)。


\(\Phi(\tau,x)=\phi_\tau(x)\)
单值局部有限时间演化；当 \(f\in C^1\) 时联合 \(C^1\)。



时钟时间 \(t\) 把状态定位在特定轨迹上。经过时间 \(\tau\) 索引自治规则推进初始状态多远。自治性使得相同单参数记号 \(\phi_\tau\) 可以不依赖 \(t_0\) 数值使用。





公式 \(\dot{x}=f(x)\) 本身不解决解是否存在、唯一或全局持续。对上述开欧氏域，以下充分条件构成有用阶梯。








对 \(f\) 的假设
此处使用的推论
不自动获得的内容




\(f\) 是任意映射
表达式给每个状态赋予候选瞬时向量。
甚至局部存在性也不保证。


\(f\) 连续
对每个 \((t_0,x_0)\)，由 Peano 定理的自治形式至少存在一个局部解。因为 \(\dot{x}=f(x)\) 随后沿解连续，每个经典解是 \(C^1\) (Teschl 2012年, sec. 2.7)。
解不必唯一。


\(f\) 局部利普希茨
局部利普希茨连续性蕴含连续性。Picard–Lindelöf 因此给出局部存在性与唯一性，兼容局部片段组装成唯一极大解。极大解定义带恒等与（在定义处）复合的单值局部有限时间演化 (Teschl 2012年, secs. 2.2, 2.6)。
不蕴含全局存在性与对初始状态的联合可微性。


\(f\in C^k(\mathcal{X},\mathbb{R}^n)\)，\(k\geq1\)
唯一解曲线对时间 \(C^{k+1}\)。受支持集 \(W\) 是开的，联合局部流映射 \(\Phi:W\to\mathcal{X}\) 在 \((\tau,x)\) 上 \(C^k\) (Teschl 2012年, secs. 2.2, 6.2)。
即使光滑性也不阻止有限时间爆破或离开真开域。



此处局部利普希茨指每个 \(x\in\mathcal{X}\) 都有邻域 \(U\subseteq\mathcal{X}\) 与有限常数 \(L_U\)，使得
\[
\|f(y)-f(z)\|\leq L_U\|y-z\|
\qquad
\text{for all }y,z\in U.
\]
该阶梯给出充分而非逻辑必要条件。某些连续非利普希茨场仍有唯一解，某些更少正则的设定承认其他存在性或唯一性定理。范围化结论只是连续性与局部利普希茨连续性干净地分离基本存在性与基本唯一性。



存在性询问：

是否至少有一条穿过 \((t_0,x_0)\) 的可微曲线满足方程？

唯一性询问：

如果两条这样的曲线在同一参考时间穿过相同初始状态，它们是否必须在其公共定义域上重合？

定理可以回答第一个问题而不回答第二个。该区分对流记号重要：只有当在有效假设下从 \(x_0\) 的演化单值，或已声明额外选择规则时，\(\phi_\tau(x_0)\) 才是单一状态。



现在假设 \(f\) 连续且 \(x:I\to\mathcal{X}\) 是 IVP 的经典解。则 \(f\circ x\) 连续，因此 \(\dot{x}=f\circ x\) 连续且 \(x\in C^1(I,\mathcal{X})\)。微积分基本定理因此给出
\[
x(t)-x_0
=
\int_{t_0}^{t}\dot{x}(s)\,ds
=
\int_{t_0}^{t}f\bigl(x(s)\bigr)\,ds.
\]
因此每个解满足
\[
x(t)=x_0+\int_{t_0}^{t}f\bigl(x(s)\bigr)\,ds.
\]
反过来，设 \(f\) 连续且连续曲线 \(x:I\to\mathcal{X}\) 对每个 \(t\in I\) 满足该积分方程。则 \(s\mapsto f(x(s))\) 连续。右侧积分因此 \(C^1\)，所以 \(x\) 是 \(C^1\)，微分给出 \(\dot{x}(t)=f(x(t))\)；令 \(t=t_0\) 给出 \(x(t_0)=x_0\)。因此在该连续 \(f\) 经典解设定中，微分与积分表述等价。Picard 迭代在更强局部利普希茨假设下把积分方程用作不动点问题 (Teschl 2012年, sec. 2.2)。



假设局部存在性与唯一性。对初始状态 \(x_0\)，设 \(x(\cdot;t_0,x_0)\) 表示其极大解。自治性允许有限时间映射
\[
\phi_\tau(x_0)
=
x(t_0+\tau;t_0,x_0),
\]
只要 \(t_0+\tau\) 位于极大区间内。结果不依赖 \(t_0\) 数值选择：移位时钟时间移位自治解，而不改变经过时间演化规则。
对单个固定 \(x_0\)，
\[
t\mapsto x(t)=\phi_{t-t_0}(x_0)
\]
是一条轨迹。相反，流同时变化经过时间与初始状态：
\[
(\tau,x_0)\mapsto\phi_\tau(x_0).
\]
恒等关系因为尚未经过时间而成立。复合关系来自自治性与唯一性：作为新经过时间变量的函数，两个延拓都从中间状态 \(\phi_s(x)\) 开始并求解相同 IVP，因此它们在都有定义处一致。这些恒等式不要求对 \(x_0\) 的可微性。



对局部利普希茨 \(f\)，单个曲线 \(\tau\mapsto\phi_\tau(x)\) 是 \(C^1\) 的，其瞬时生成元是
\[
f(x)
=
\left.\frac{d}{d\tau}\phi_\tau(x)\right|_{\tau=0}.
\]
该导数只对经过时间取。如果 \(f\in C^1\)，更强结论是 \(\Phi(\tau,x)\) 对 \(\tau\) 与 \(x\) 联合 \(C^1\)。反过来，满足恒等与复合的联合可微局部流通过零点导数关系生成自治向量场，其流曲线满足相应 ODE (Teschl 2012年, sec. 6.2, problem 6.5)。因此瞬时与有限时间描述被连接，而不把一条轨迹的时间可微性与对初始状态的可微依赖混为一谈。




中心逻辑链是：

选择可取状态。 声明开域 \(\mathcal{X}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n\)。
赋予瞬时变化。 指定 \(f:\mathcal{X}\to\mathbb{R}^n\)。
约束曲线。 要求可微 \(x:I\to\mathcal{X}\) 满足 \(\dot{x}(t)=f(x(t))\)。
锚定曲线。 添加 \(x(t_0)=x_0\) 形成 IVP。
援引相关正则性结果。 连续性提供至少一个局部解；局部利普希茨连续性还提供局部唯一性。
尽可能延拓。 因为在局部利普希茨梯级局部存在性与唯一性都成立，兼容局部片段组合成 \(I_{t_0,x_0}\) 上的唯一极大解。
用经过时间重新索引。 设 \(\tau=t-t_0\) 并在受支持处定义 \(\phi_\tau(x_0)=x(t_0+\tau;t_0,x_0)\)。
用唯一性复合。 从 \(x\) 演化 \(s\) 到达 \(\phi_s(x)\)。从那里开始演化 \(\tau\) 与从 \(x\) 演化 \(s+\tau\) 求解相同 IVP，因此
\[
\phi_{\tau+s}(x)=\phi_\tau(\phi_s(x)).
\]
在零经过时间微分。 因为局部利普希茨 \(f\) 连续，每条解曲线对 \(\tau\) 是 \(C^1\)，其局部斜率恢复瞬时规则：
\[
\left.\frac{d}{d\tau}\phi_\tau(x)\right|_{\tau=0}=f(x).
\]
这是沿经过时间坐标的导数。对 \((\tau,x)\) 的联合 \(C^1\) 依赖只在更强 \(f\in C^1\) 梯级被断言。

该链中没有一步把局部存在性变成全局存在性。例如，\(\mathbb{R}\) 上光滑场 \(f(x)=x^2\) 对 \(x_0>0\) 具有解
\[
x(t)=\frac{x_0}{1-x_0(t-t_0)}
\]
其极大区间是
\[
(-\infty,t_0+1/x_0),
\]
因为解在 \(t\uparrow t_0+1/x_0\) 时发散。光滑性给出局部唯一性与光滑局部流，而非 \(\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}\) 上的全局流 (Teschl 2012年, secs. 1.3, 6.2)。



在每个 \(x\in\mathcal{X}\)，向量 \(f(x)\) 是带「状态每单位时间」单位的局部箭头。兼容轨迹在其访问的每个状态与该箭头相切：
\[
\text{trajectory tangent at }x(t)
=
\dot{x}(t)
=
f(x(t)).
\]
流询问不同问题。\(\phi_\tau\) 不只在一点显示箭头，而是把每个受支持初始点运输过有限经过时间 \(\tau\)。固定点给出一条轨迹；固定经过时间给出一个状态到状态映射。
这幅图是直觉，不是测得数据拥有向量场或流的证据。拟合到样本的箭头与显示在投影中的曲线继承状态定义、采样过程与拟合模型的假设。



考虑标量 IVP
\[
\frac{dx}{dt}=a x,
\qquad
x(t_0)=x_0,
\]
其中 \(a\in\mathbb{R}\) 固定。


把状态乘以积分因子 \(e^{-a(t-t_0)}\)。由乘积法则，
\[
\begin{aligned}
\frac{d}{dt}\left(e^{-a(t-t_0)}x(t)\right)
&=
-a e^{-a(t-t_0)}x(t)
+e^{-a(t-t_0)}\dot{x}(t)\\
&=
e^{-a(t-t_0)}\bigl(\dot{x}(t)-a x(t)\bigr)\\
&=0.
\end{aligned}
\]
因此 \(e^{-a(t-t_0)}x(t)\) 在 \(t\) 中恒定。在 \(t=t_0\) 求该常值给出
\[
e^{-a(t_0-t_0)}x(t_0)=x_0.
\]
因此
\[
x(t)=x_0e^{a(t-t_0)}.
\]
该推导也覆盖 \(x_0=0\)，无需除以状态。



微分所提解：
\[
\dot{x}(t)
=
a x_0e^{a(t-t_0)}
=
a x(t).
\]
在参考时间，
\[
x(t_0)=x_0e^0=x_0.
\]
因此它同时满足 ODE 与初始条件。




状态空间： \(\mathcal{X}=\mathbb{R}\)。
状态值： \(x(t)\in\mathbb{R}\)。
向量场： \(f(x)=ax\)。
初始状态： 参考时间 \(t_0\) 处的 \(x_0\)。
轨迹： 对所选 \(x_0\)，\(t\mapsto x_0e^{a(t-t_0)}\)。
经过时间流：
\[
\phi_\tau(x)=xe^{a\tau}.
\]

该场全局利普希茨，因为
\[
|f(x)-f(y)|=|a|\,|x-y|.
\]
解对每个实数 \(t\) 有限，因此该示例具有全局流。



恒等：
\[
\phi_0(x)=xe^{a\cdot0}=x.
\]
复合：
\[
\begin{aligned}
\phi_\tau\bigl(\phi_s(x)\bigr)
&=\phi_\tau(xe^{as})\\
&=(xe^{as})e^{a\tau}\\
&=xe^{a(\tau+s)}\\
&=\phi_{\tau+s}(x).
\end{aligned}
\]
生成元：
\[
\left.\frac{d}{d\tau}\phi_\tau(x)\right|_{\tau=0}
=
\left.a xe^{a\tau}\right|_{\tau=0}
=
ax
=
f(x).
\]
该示例使三个层级显式：\(f(x)=ax\) 给出瞬时变化，\(\phi_\tau(x)=xe^{a\tau}\) 给出跨初始状态的有限时间演化，选择一个 \(x_0\) 产生一条轨迹。



对有界二维示例，设状态为
\[
z(t)=
\begin{pmatrix}
x(t)\\
y(t)
\end{pmatrix}
\in\mathbb{R}^2
\]
并固定参数 \(a,\omega\in\mathbb{R}\)。考虑自治 IVP
\[
\dot z=Az,
\qquad
A=
\begin{pmatrix}
a & -\omega\\
\omega & a
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
z(t_0)=z_0.
\]
定义平面旋转矩阵
\[
R(\theta)
=
\begin{pmatrix}
\cos\theta & -\sin\theta\\
\sin\theta & \cos\theta
\end{pmatrix}.
\]
用经过时间 \(\tau=t-t_0\)，提出
\[
z(t_0+\tau)
=
e^{a\tau}R(\omega\tau)z_0.
\]
当 \(\omega\neq0\) 时，旋转改变角位置而因子 \(e^{a\tau}\) 改变半径：\(a<0\) 给出向内螺旋，\(a=0\) 给出恒定半径旋转，\(a>0\) 给出向外螺旋。这些描述只关乎这个声明系统；它们不从绘制轨迹推断螺旋动力学。


在零经过时间，\(e^{a\cdot0}=1\) 且 \(R(0)=I\)，因此
\[
z(t_0)=e^0R(0)z_0=z_0.
\]
设
\[
J=
\begin{pmatrix}
0 & -1\\
1 & 0
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
A=aI+\omega J.
\]
对正弦与余弦条目直接微分给出
\[
\frac{d}{d\tau}R(\omega\tau)
=
\omega J R(\omega\tau).
\]
因为 \(d\tau/dt=1\)，乘积法则给出
\[
\begin{aligned}
\dot z(t_0+\tau)
&=
e^{a\tau}
\left[aI+\omega J\right]
R(\omega\tau)z_0\\
&=
A\left[e^{a\tau}R(\omega\tau)z_0\right]\\
&=Az(t_0+\tau).
\end{aligned}
\]
因此所提曲线同时满足 ODE 与初始条件。




状态空间： \(\mathcal{X}=\mathbb{R}^2\)。
状态值： \(z(t)=(x(t),y(t))^T\in\mathbb{R}^2\)。
向量场： \(f(z)=Az\)。
初始条件： \(z(t_0)=z_0\)。
轨迹： 对所选 \(z_0\)，\(t\mapsto e^{a(t-t_0)}R(\omega(t-t_0))z_0\)。
经过时间流：
\[
\phi_\tau(z)=e^{a\tau}R(\omega\tau)z.
\]




恒等律立即可得：
\[
\phi_0(z)=e^0R(0)z=z.
\]
使用 \(e^{a\tau}e^{as}=e^{a(\tau+s)}\) 与平面旋转律 \(R(\alpha)R(\beta)=R(\alpha+\beta)\) 给出
\[
\begin{aligned}
\phi_\tau\bigl(\phi_s(z)\bigr)
&=
e^{a\tau}R(\omega\tau)
e^{as}R(\omega s)z\\
&=
e^{a(\tau+s)}R\bigl(\omega(\tau+s)\bigr)z\\
&=
\phi_{\tau+s}(z).
\end{aligned}
\]
该场在 \(\mathbb{R}^2\) 上全局利普希茨，因为对欧氏范数及其诱导矩阵范数，
\[
\|f(z)-f(w)\|
=
\|A(z-w)\|
\leq
\|A\|\,\|z-w\|.
\]
显式公式对每个 \(z\in\mathbb{R}^2\) 与每个有限 \(\tau\in\mathbb{R}\) 有限。因此受支持域是
\[
W=\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}^2,
\]
所以该系统具有全局双侧流。每个 \(\phi_\tau\) 是逆为 \(\phi_{-\tau}\) 的全局定义双射。\(a>0\) 时向外增长在 \(\tau\to\infty\) 时无界，但不造成有限时间爆破。




现在考虑
\[
\dot{x}=\sqrt{|x|},
\qquad
x(0)=0,
\qquad
\mathcal{X}=\mathbb{R}.
\]
向量场 \(f(x)=\sqrt{|x|}\) 连续，因此 Peano 定理保证穿过 \((0,0)\) 至少一个局部解。它在 \(0\) 处不局部利普希茨，因为对 \(x\neq0\)，
\[
\frac{|f(x)-f(0)|}{|x-0|}
=
\frac{\sqrt{|x|}}{|x|}
=
\frac{1}{\sqrt{|x|}},
\]
在 \(x\to0\) 时无界。
一个解是
\[
x(t)=0.
\]
对每个等待时间 \(c\geq0\)，另一个解是
\[
x_c(t)=
\begin{cases}
0, & t\leq c,\\
\dfrac{(t-c)^2}{4}, & t\geq c.
\end{cases}
\]
对 \(t<c\)，\(\dot{x}_c(t)\) 与 \(\sqrt{|x_c(t)|}\) 都为零。对 \(t>c\)，
\[
\dot{x}_c(t)=\frac{t-c}{2}
=
\sqrt{\frac{(t-c)^2}{4}}
=
\sqrt{|x_c(t)|}.
\]
在 \(t=c\)，左右导数都为零，因此 \(x_c\) 在那里可微。因为 \(c\geq0\)，每条这样的曲线也满足 \(x_c(0)=0\)。因此同一 IVP 有无限多个解。这是 Teschl 平方根示例展示的标准非唯一性机制 (Teschl 2012年, sec. 1.3)。
教训是精确的：连续性在此支持存在性，但失败的局部利普希茨条件移除基本唯一性保证。因此 ODE 与初始状态单独不在正经过时间后确定唯一值 \(\phi_\tau(0)\)，从而不诱导唯一确定的单值流。





把方程当作曲线而非约束。 表达式 \(\dot{x}=f(x)\) 指定哪些可微曲线有资格作为解；它本身不是一条轨迹。
把存在性与唯一性等同。 连续场可以承认解，而不从初始状态选择恰好一个解。
把局部与全局等同。 局部利普希茨连续性给出局部存在性与唯一性，从而唯一极大延拓，而非全时解。
忽略声明域。 解必须保持在 \(\mathcal{X}\) 内。到达其边界可以在坐标值保持有界时结束极大解。
互换使用 \(t\) 与 \(\tau\)。 时钟时间相对 \(t_0\) 标记轨迹；经过时间索引自治演化映射。
把一条轨迹称为流。 一个固定 \(x_0\) 给出一条轨迹。流组织跨多个初始状态的演化，并必须在定义处满足恒等与复合。
假设每个向量场都有全局流。 即使光滑向量场也可以有限时间爆破。
从显示推断场。 绘制曲线或拟合箭头场本身不是唯一自治机制的证据。

该形式体系也并不蕴含：

每个观测时间序列都是动力系统轨迹；
每个时变潜表示都承认有效自治向量场；
一条观测轨迹唯一确定向量场，无论在未完全采样状态之外或沿其；
多条相似轨迹证明一个共享流；
预测成功确立机制正确性；
推断潜状态是唯一真实物理状态；
所有系统自治或连续时间；
所有科学相关状态空间欧氏；或
所有向量场生成全局流。




给定声明 \(f\)、\(x_0\) 与 \(t_0\)，数值 ODE 求解器在请求时间区间上近似一条解轨迹。步长、误差控制、刚度、域边界与有限时间发散影响计算是否可靠。数值输出不取代此处处理的解析问题：解是否存在、是否唯一，以及请求区间是否位于其极大域内。
流视角在计算上对应为许多初始状态与经过时间求解相同 ODE。有限模拟网格采样所提出的流；它不是完整映射 \(\Phi:W\to\mathcal{X}\)。同样，从数据估计 \(f\) 是涉及采样、观测、噪声、可辨识性与基线的单独方法问题。它不是本数学定义的一部分。



本对象形式化而非取代六个 Cycle 1 概念：



概念
在自治 IVP 中的形式角色




State
\(x(t)\) 是时钟时间 \(t\) 携带的状态值。


State Space
\(x(t)\in\mathcal{X}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n\)。


Initial Condition
\(x(t_0)=x_0\) 在参考时间锚定演化。


Vector Field
\(f:\mathcal{X}\to\mathbb{R}^n\) 赋予瞬时变化。


Trajectory
\(t\mapsto x(t)\) 是唯一性成立时由初始条件选择的一个解。


Flow
\((\tau,x_0)\mapsto\phi_\tau(x_0)\) 组织跨受支持初始状态的有限时间演化。



对 LDG，主要方法学边界是声明 ODE 模型内的数学自洽不是测得神经、行为或潜变量遵循该模型的经验证据。后续玩具模型可以使用本对象指定已知真值。真实数据主张将额外需要论证状态描述、观测模型、估计规程、更简单基线与区分自治共享规则与输入、非平稳性、被省略状态和测量伪迹的检验。




IVP 解的存在性、唯一性、光滑性、积分形式与延拓：(Teschl 2012年, ch. 2)。
演示全局演化、有限时间爆破与非唯一性的标量自治示例：(Teschl 2012年, sec. 1.3)。
极大积分曲线、受支持域 \(W\)、局部流复合与无穷小生成元：(Teschl 2012年, sec. 6.2)。





使用六个稳定 Cycle 1 概念作为规范前置知识。
以良类型化定义域与值域陈述自治欧氏 IVP。
分离连续性、局部利普希茨连续性与更强光滑性。
区分存在性与唯一性，以及局部、极大与全局解。
定义受支持局部流域，并只在定义处陈述恒等与复合。
通过零点导数把可微局部流与其向量场联系起来。
包含并验证完整 \(\dot{x}=ax\) 轨迹与流推导。
包含解析检查的二维旋转–伸缩轨迹与全局流。
包含检查的非唯一性示例与有界有限时间爆破边界。
陈述经验与建模非蕴含，而不进入被排除的下游主题。
完成一次内部数学一致性 / 红队遍历。
应用独立 L2 数学审查的有界修正。
独立聚焦复审确认修订陈述；所有者于 2026-08-18 批准晋升为 L2 / stable。

title: 一阶自治动力系统
text:
六个 Cycle 1 概念区分 state、其 state space、trajectory、initial condition、vector field 与 flow。本数学对象把这些角色连接在一个可复用连续时间表述中：
\[
\frac{dx}{dt}=f(x),
\qquad
x(t_0)=x_0.
\]
微分方程不只是绘制曲线的紧凑描述。它是对未知可微状态轨迹的约束。存在性、唯一性、延拓与有限时间流陈述需要单独假设。在后续 LDG 工作可以把自治 ODE 用作生成模型或恢复目标之前，使这些假设显式是必要的。
范围刻意很窄：\(\mathcal{X}\) 是 \(\mathbb{R}^n\) 的开子集，时间是连续的，规则是确定性与自治的。离散时间、随机、输入驱动、显式时间相关与非欧氏系统在本对象之外。

title: 一阶自治动力系统
text:
State：模型在一个时间携带的状态值。
State Space：该状态的可取值。
Trajectory：一条以时间为参数的演化。
Initial Condition：赋值 \(x(t_0)=x_0\)。
Vector Field：瞬时状态变化规则。
Flow：跨受支持初始状态的有限时间演化。

假定背景： 初等集合、函数、欧氏向量、单变量微分与积分、链式法则与函数复合。

title: 一阶自治动力系统
text:
设
\[
\mathcal{X}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n
\]
是开的，并设
\[
f:\mathcal{X}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^n.
\]
方程
\[
\dot{x}=f(x)
\]
是一阶自治常微分方程。它是一阶的，因为最高阶导数是 \(\dot{x}\)；它是自治的，因为右侧依赖当前状态 \(x\) 而不显式依赖时钟时间 \(t\)。
区间 \(I\subseteq\mathbb{R}\) 上的解是可微曲线
\[
x:I\rightarrow\mathcal{X}
\]
使得对每个 \(t\in I\)，
\[
\dot{x}(t)=f\bigl(x(t)\bigr).
\]
因此 \(x(t)\) 是 \(\mathcal{X}\) 中的状态值，而 \(\dot{x}(t)\) 与 \(f(x(t))\) 都是 \(\mathbb{R}^n\) 中的向量。方程要求轨迹在每个访问状态与 \(f\) 赋予的向量相切。



对参考时间 \(t_0\) 与初始状态 \(x_0\in\mathcal{X}\)，初值问题（IVP）是
\[
\dot{x}=f(x),
\qquad
x(t_0)=x_0.
\]
IVP 的解必须同时满足微分方程与初始条件。规则 \(f\) 描述其定义域上可能的瞬时演化；初始条件选择在 \(t_0\) 穿过 \(x_0\) 的解或解集。




局部解定义在包含 \(t_0\) 的开区间 \(I\) 上。
如果解不能延拓到严格更大区间同时保持为 \(\mathcal{X}\) 中的解，则它是极大的。如果 IVP 承认唯一局部解——即局部解存在且任何两个兼容局部解在其公共定义域上一致——那些局部片段组装成开极大区间
\[
I_{t_0,x_0}=(T_-(t_0,x_0),T_+(t_0,x_0)).
\]
上的唯一极大解。
本对象全时设定中的全局解对每个 \(t\in\mathbb{R}\) 有定义，因此其极大区间是 \(\mathbb{R}\)。

局部存在性与唯一性不蕴含全局存在性。在相同局部可解性假设下，如果极大解具有有限前向端点 \(T_+\)，则当 \(t\uparrow T_+\) 时它最终离开 \(\mathcal{X}\) 的每个紧子集。当 \(\mathcal{X}=\mathbb{R}^n\) 时，这意味着 \(\|x(t)\|\to\infty\)。在真开域上，轨迹可以保持有界同时接近 \(\mathcal{X}\) 的补集；它不必收敛到某个特定边界点。类似陈述在有限后向端点成立。Teschl 把局部可解性与极大延拓分开，并明确陈述该紧集准则 (Teschl 2012年, secs. 2.2, 2.6)。



从初始条件度量时间是有用的。把
\[
\tau=t-t_0
\]
写为经过时间。对每个 \(x\in\mathcal{X}\)，假设在经过时间 0 穿过 \(x\) 的唯一极大解定义在包含 \(0\) 的区间 \(I_x\) 上。定义
\[
W=\{(\tau,x)\in\mathbb{R}\times\mathcal{X}:\tau\in I_x\}.
\]
集合 \(W\) 记录哪些经过时间/状态对受支持。它不必等于 \(\mathbb{R}\times\mathcal{X}\)：状态可以只支持有限的前向或后向演化区间。对固定经过时间 \(\tau\)，有限时间映射具有类型化定义域
\[
\operatorname{dom}(\phi_\tau)
=
\{x\in\mathcal{X}:(\tau,x)\in W\}.
\]


在局部存在性与唯一性下，极大解定义单值映射
\[
\Phi:W\rightarrow\mathcal{X},
\qquad
(\tau,x)\mapsto\Phi(\tau,x)=\phi_\tau(x).
\]
该局部演化族满足
\[
\phi_0(x)=x
\]
且只要各项有定义，
\[
\phi_{\tau+s}(x)=\phi_\tau\bigl(\phi_s(x)\bigr).
\]
更显式地，如果 \(s\in I_x\) 且 \(\tau\in I_{\phi_s(x)}\)，则 \(s+\tau\in I_x\)，且先演化 \(s\) 再演化 \(\tau\) 与演化组合经过时间 \(s+\tau\) 一致。这些代数性质来自自治性与唯一性。它们本身不断言在 \((\tau,x)\) 上的联合连续性或可微性。
当 \(f\) 局部利普希茨时它是连续的，因此每条单个曲线 \(\tau\mapsto\phi_\tau(x)\) 对经过时间 \(C^1\) 且满足
\[
\frac{d}{d\tau}\phi_\tau(x)
=
f\bigl(\phi_\tau(x)\bigr).
\]
特别地，
\[
\left.\frac{d}{d\tau}\phi_\tau(x)\right|_{\tau=0}
=
f(x).
\]
这是沿一条轨迹对 \(\tau\) 的可微性；它尚不是对初始状态 \(x\) 可微性的主张。



如果 \(f\in C^1(\mathcal{X},\mathbb{R}^n)\)，Teschl 的光滑依赖结果给出 \(W\) 是开的，且联合映射
\[
\Phi:W\rightarrow\mathcal{X},
\qquad
(\tau,x)\mapsto\Phi(\tau,x)=\phi_\tau(x),
\]
对经过时间与初始状态联合 \(C^1\)。在采用的 LDG 约定下，这个联合 \(C^1\) 映射连同上述恒等与复合律是 \(f\) 生成的局部流。更一般地，\(f\in C^k\) 且 \(k\geq1\) 给出联合 \(C^k\) 局部流映射 (Teschl 2012年, sec. 6.2)。

title: 一阶自治动力系统
text:
符号
角色




\(\mathcal{X}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n\)
开欧氏状态空间域。


\(x\in\mathcal{X}\)
一个可取状态值。


\(x(t)\)
一条轨迹上时钟时间 \(t\) 的状态值。


\(t_0\)
IVP 的参考时钟时间。


\(x_0\)
满足 \(x(t_0)=x_0\) 的初始状态。


\(f:\mathcal{X}\to\mathbb{R}^n\)
自治向量场。


\(\dot{x}(t)\)
轨迹的瞬时导数。


\(I_{t_0,x_0}\)
穿过 \((t_0,x_0)\) 的解的极大时钟时间区间。


\(\tau=t-t_0\)
相对参考时间的经过时间。


\(I_x\)
在 \(\tau=0\) 穿过 \(x\) 的解的极大经过时间区间。


\(W\)
受支持的经过时间/状态对 \((\tau,x)\)。


\(\operatorname{dom}(\phi_\tau)\)
满足 \((\tau,x)\in W\) 的状态 \(x\)。


\(\Phi(\tau,x)=\phi_\tau(x)\)
单值局部有限时间演化；当 \(f\in C^1\) 时联合 \(C^1\)。



时钟时间 \(t\) 把状态定位在特定轨迹上。经过时间 \(\tau\) 索引自治规则推进初始状态多远。自治性使得相同单参数记号 \(\phi_\tau\) 可以不依赖 \(t_0\) 数值使用。

title: 一阶自治动力系统
text:
公式 \(\dot{x}=f(x)\) 本身不解决解是否存在、唯一或全局持续。对上述开欧氏域，以下充分条件构成有用阶梯。








对 \(f\) 的假设
此处使用的推论
不自动获得的内容




\(f\) 是任意映射
表达式给每个状态赋予候选瞬时向量。
甚至局部存在性也不保证。


\(f\) 连续
对每个 \((t_0,x_0)\)，由 Peano 定理的自治形式至少存在一个局部解。因为 \(\dot{x}=f(x)\) 随后沿解连续，每个经典解是 \(C^1\) (Teschl 2012年, sec. 2.7)。
解不必唯一。


\(f\) 局部利普希茨
局部利普希茨连续性蕴含连续性。Picard–Lindelöf 因此给出局部存在性与唯一性，兼容局部片段组装成唯一极大解。极大解定义带恒等与（在定义处）复合的单值局部有限时间演化 (Teschl 2012年, secs. 2.2, 2.6)。
不蕴含全局存在性与对初始状态的联合可微性。


\(f\in C^k(\mathcal{X},\mathbb{R}^n)\)，\(k\geq1\)
唯一解曲线对时间 \(C^{k+1}\)。受支持集 \(W\) 是开的，联合局部流映射 \(\Phi:W\to\mathcal{X}\) 在 \((\tau,x)\) 上 \(C^k\) (Teschl 2012年, secs. 2.2, 6.2)。
即使光滑性也不阻止有限时间爆破或离开真开域。



此处局部利普希茨指每个 \(x\in\mathcal{X}\) 都有邻域 \(U\subseteq\mathcal{X}\) 与有限常数 \(L_U\)，使得
\[
\|f(y)-f(z)\|\leq L_U\|y-z\|
\qquad
\text{for all }y,z\in U.
\]
该阶梯给出充分而非逻辑必要条件。某些连续非利普希茨场仍有唯一解，某些更少正则的设定承认其他存在性或唯一性定理。范围化结论只是连续性与局部利普希茨连续性干净地分离基本存在性与基本唯一性。



存在性询问：

是否至少有一条穿过 \((t_0,x_0)\) 的可微曲线满足方程？

唯一性询问：

如果两条这样的曲线在同一参考时间穿过相同初始状态，它们是否必须在其公共定义域上重合？

定理可以回答第一个问题而不回答第二个。该区分对流记号重要：只有当在有效假设下从 \(x_0\) 的演化单值，或已声明额外选择规则时，\(\phi_\tau(x_0)\) 才是单一状态。



现在假设 \(f\) 连续且 \(x:I\to\mathcal{X}\) 是 IVP 的经典解。则 \(f\circ x\) 连续，因此 \(\dot{x}=f\circ x\) 连续且 \(x\in C^1(I,\mathcal{X})\)。微积分基本定理因此给出
\[
x(t)-x_0
=
\int_{t_0}^{t}\dot{x}(s)\,ds
=
\int_{t_0}^{t}f\bigl(x(s)\bigr)\,ds.
\]
因此每个解满足
\[
x(t)=x_0+\int_{t_0}^{t}f\bigl(x(s)\bigr)\,ds.
\]
反过来，设 \(f\) 连续且连续曲线 \(x:I\to\mathcal{X}\) 对每个 \(t\in I\) 满足该积分方程。则 \(s\mapsto f(x(s))\) 连续。右侧积分因此 \(C^1\)，所以 \(x\) 是 \(C^1\)，微分给出 \(\dot{x}(t)=f(x(t))\)；令 \(t=t_0\) 给出 \(x(t_0)=x_0\)。因此在该连续 \(f\) 经典解设定中，微分与积分表述等价。Picard 迭代在更强局部利普希茨假设下把积分方程用作不动点问题 (Teschl 2012年, sec. 2.2)。



假设局部存在性与唯一性。对初始状态 \(x_0\)，设 \(x(\cdot;t_0,x_0)\) 表示其极大解。自治性允许有限时间映射
\[
\phi_\tau(x_0)
=
x(t_0+\tau;t_0,x_0),
\]
只要 \(t_0+\tau\) 位于极大区间内。结果不依赖 \(t_0\) 数值选择：移位时钟时间移位自治解，而不改变经过时间演化规则。
对单个固定 \(x_0\)，
\[
t\mapsto x(t)=\phi_{t-t_0}(x_0)
\]
是一条轨迹。相反，流同时变化经过时间与初始状态：
\[
(\tau,x_0)\mapsto\phi_\tau(x_0).
\]
恒等关系因为尚未经过时间而成立。复合关系来自自治性与唯一性：作为新经过时间变量的函数，两个延拓都从中间状态 \(\phi_s(x)\) 开始并求解相同 IVP，因此它们在都有定义处一致。这些恒等式不要求对 \(x_0\) 的可微性。



对局部利普希茨 \(f\)，单个曲线 \(\tau\mapsto\phi_\tau(x)\) 是 \(C^1\) 的，其瞬时生成元是
\[
f(x)
=
\left.\frac{d}{d\tau}\phi_\tau(x)\right|_{\tau=0}.
\]
该导数只对经过时间取。如果 \(f\in C^1\)，更强结论是 \(\Phi(\tau,x)\) 对 \(\tau\) 与 \(x\) 联合 \(C^1\)。反过来，满足恒等与复合的联合可微局部流通过零点导数关系生成自治向量场，其流曲线满足相应 ODE (Teschl 2012年, sec. 6.2, problem 6.5)。因此瞬时与有限时间描述被连接，而不把一条轨迹的时间可微性与对初始状态的可微依赖混为一谈。

title: 一阶自治动力系统
text:
中心逻辑链是：

选择可取状态。 声明开域 \(\mathcal{X}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n\)。
赋予瞬时变化。 指定 \(f:\mathcal{X}\to\mathbb{R}^n\)。
约束曲线。 要求可微 \(x:I\to\mathcal{X}\) 满足 \(\dot{x}(t)=f(x(t))\)。
锚定曲线。 添加 \(x(t_0)=x_0\) 形成 IVP。
援引相关正则性结果。 连续性提供至少一个局部解；局部利普希茨连续性还提供局部唯一性。
尽可能延拓。 因为在局部利普希茨梯级局部存在性与唯一性都成立，兼容局部片段组合成 \(I_{t_0,x_0}\) 上的唯一极大解。
用经过时间重新索引。 设 \(\tau=t-t_0\) 并在受支持处定义 \(\phi_\tau(x_0)=x(t_0+\tau;t_0,x_0)\)。
用唯一性复合。 从 \(x\) 演化 \(s\) 到达 \(\phi_s(x)\)。从那里开始演化 \(\tau\) 与从 \(x\) 演化 \(s+\tau\) 求解相同 IVP，因此
\[
\phi_{\tau+s}(x)=\phi_\tau(\phi_s(x)).
\]
在零经过时间微分。 因为局部利普希茨 \(f\) 连续，每条解曲线对 \(\tau\) 是 \(C^1\)，其局部斜率恢复瞬时规则：
\[
\left.\frac{d}{d\tau}\phi_\tau(x)\right|_{\tau=0}=f(x).
\]
这是沿经过时间坐标的导数。对 \((\tau,x)\) 的联合 \(C^1\) 依赖只在更强 \(f\in C^1\) 梯级被断言。

该链中没有一步把局部存在性变成全局存在性。例如，\(\mathbb{R}\) 上光滑场 \(f(x)=x^2\) 对 \(x_0>0\) 具有解
\[
x(t)=\frac{x_0}{1-x_0(t-t_0)}
\]
其极大区间是
\[
(-\infty,t_0+1/x_0),
\]
因为解在 \(t\uparrow t_0+1/x_0\) 时发散。光滑性给出局部唯一性与光滑局部流，而非 \(\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}\) 上的全局流 (Teschl 2012年, secs. 1.3, 6.2)。

title: 一阶自治动力系统
text:
在每个 \(x\in\mathcal{X}\)，向量 \(f(x)\) 是带「状态每单位时间」单位的局部箭头。兼容轨迹在其访问的每个状态与该箭头相切：
\[
\text{trajectory tangent at }x(t)
=
\dot{x}(t)
=
f(x(t)).
\]
流询问不同问题。\(\phi_\tau\) 不只在一点显示箭头，而是把每个受支持初始点运输过有限经过时间 \(\tau\)。固定点给出一条轨迹；固定经过时间给出一个状态到状态映射。
这幅图是直觉，不是测得数据拥有向量场或流的证据。拟合到样本的箭头与显示在投影中的曲线继承状态定义、采样过程与拟合模型的假设。

title: 一阶自治动力系统
text:
考虑标量 IVP
\[
\frac{dx}{dt}=a x,
\qquad
x(t_0)=x_0,
\]
其中 \(a\in\mathbb{R}\) 固定。


把状态乘以积分因子 \(e^{-a(t-t_0)}\)。由乘积法则，
\[
\begin{aligned}
\frac{d}{dt}\left(e^{-a(t-t_0)}x(t)\right)
&=
-a e^{-a(t-t_0)}x(t)
+e^{-a(t-t_0)}\dot{x}(t)\\
&=
e^{-a(t-t_0)}\bigl(\dot{x}(t)-a x(t)\bigr)\\
&=0.
\end{aligned}
\]
因此 \(e^{-a(t-t_0)}x(t)\) 在 \(t\) 中恒定。在 \(t=t_0\) 求该常值给出
\[
e^{-a(t_0-t_0)}x(t_0)=x_0.
\]
因此
\[
x(t)=x_0e^{a(t-t_0)}.
\]
该推导也覆盖 \(x_0=0\)，无需除以状态。



微分所提解：
\[
\dot{x}(t)
=
a x_0e^{a(t-t_0)}
=
a x(t).
\]
在参考时间，
\[
x(t_0)=x_0e^0=x_0.
\]
因此它同时满足 ODE 与初始条件。




状态空间： \(\mathcal{X}=\mathbb{R}\)。
状态值： \(x(t)\in\mathbb{R}\)。
向量场： \(f(x)=ax\)。
初始状态： 参考时间 \(t_0\) 处的 \(x_0\)。
轨迹： 对所选 \(x_0\)，\(t\mapsto x_0e^{a(t-t_0)}\)。
经过时间流：
\[
\phi_\tau(x)=xe^{a\tau}.
\]

该场全局利普希茨，因为
\[
|f(x)-f(y)|=|a|\,|x-y|.
\]
解对每个实数 \(t\) 有限，因此该示例具有全局流。



恒等：
\[
\phi_0(x)=xe^{a\cdot0}=x.
\]
复合：
\[
